scripts.title: dtexe v3
scripts.author: Gilangboy
scripts.summary: Now is v3 V1 later because I uploaded it carelessly
scripts.code:
-- DTEXE V3 FE | RED BLACK EDITION
-- LocalScript - StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DTEXE_V3"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local RED = Color3.fromRGB(190, 0, 0)
local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- Main window
local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 350)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.5, -175)
main.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
main.BorderColor3 = RED
main.BorderSizePixel = 2
main.Parent = gui

local top = Instance.new("TextButton")
top.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 42)
top.BackgroundColor3 = RED
top.Text = "DTEXE V3 FE"
top.TextColor3 = WHITE
top.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
top.TextSize = 18
top.Parent = main

local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 42)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0)
close.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
close.Text = "X"
close.TextColor3 = WHITE
close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
close.TextSize = 18
close.Parent = main

local reopen = Instance.new("TextButton")
reopen.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 40)
reopen.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
reopen.BackgroundColor3 = RED
reopen.Text = "OPEN DTEXE"
reopen.TextColor3 = WHITE
reopen.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
reopen.Parent = gui
reopen.Visible = false

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = false
    reopen.Visible = true
end)

reopen.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    main.Visible = true
    reopen.Visible = false
end)

-- Drag support: mouse and touch
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPosition

top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- Scroll
local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scroll.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 50)
scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -82)
scroll.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 5
scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = RED
scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
scroll.Parent = main

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
layout.Parent = scroll

local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
padding.Parent = scroll

-- Feature buttons
local function addButton(name, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 38)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
    button.BorderColor3 = RED
    button.Text = name .. " : OFF"
    button.TextColor3 = WHITE
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Parent = scroll

    local enabled = false

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        enabled = not enabled
        button.Text = name .. (enabled and " : ON" or " : OFF")
        callback(enabled)
    end)

    return button
end

local function humanoid()
    local char = plr.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

-- ESP
local highlights = {}

addButton("ESP", function(on)
    for _, h in pairs(highlights) do
        h:Destroy()
    end
    table.clear(highlights)

    if on then
        for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if target ~= plr and target.Character then
                local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
                h.FillColor = RED
                h.OutlineColor = WHITE
                h.Adornee = target.Character
                h.Parent = gui
                highlights[target] = h
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Fly follows camera
local flying = false
local flyVelocity
local flyAttachment
local flyConnection

local function stopFly()
    flying = false

    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end

    if flyVelocity then
        flyVelocity:Destroy()
        flyVelocity = nil
    end

    if flyAttachment then
        flyAttachment:Destroy()
        flyAttachment = nil
    end

    local h = humanoid()
    if h then h.PlatformStand = false end
end

addButton("FLY / UNFLY", function(on)
    if not on then
        stopFly()
        return
    end

    local char = plr.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local h = humanoid()
    if not root or not h then return end

    flying = true

    flyAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    flyAttachment.Parent = root

local function encode(text)
	local parts = {}

	for _, codepoint in utf8.codes(text) do
		table.insert(parts, "utf8.char(" .. codepoint .. ")")
	end
	
	local str = table.concat(parts, " .. "):sub(1, -1)

	return "local str = " .. str
end

local function New(class, props, parent)
    local i = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do i[k] = v end
    if parent then i.Parent = parent end
    return i
end

local function Corner(parent, r)
    New("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6)}, parent)
end

-- Drag: игнорируем нажатия на кнопки (иначе клик по ✕ не срабатывает)
local function MakeDraggable(frame, dragBar)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            local t = input.Target
            if t and t:IsA("GuiButton") then return end
            dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, frame.Position
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                                       startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
end

local function MakeToggle(parent, text, initial, callback)
    local c = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, parent)
    New("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225,225,230),
        TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, c)
    local btn = New("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 18), Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -9),
        BackgroundColor3 = initial and Color3.fromRGB(0,180,90) or Color3.fromRGB(60,60,70),
        Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, c); Corner(btn, 9)
    local knob = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14),
        Position = initial and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, btn); Corner(knob, 7)

    local state = initial
    local function set(n)
        state = n
        Tween:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(0,180,90) or Color3.fromRGB(60,60,70)}):Play()
        Tween:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7)}):Play()
        if callback then callback(state) end
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(not state) end)
    return {Set = set, Get = function() return state end, Frame = c}
end

local function MakeSlider(parent, text, min, max, initial, callback)
    local c = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 42), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, parent)
    New("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225,225,230),
        TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, c)
    local val = New("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = tostring(math.floor(initial)),
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140,190,255), TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
    }, c)
    local barBg = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,50), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, c); Corner(barBg, 3)
    local fill = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new((initial - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100,150,255), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, barBg); Corner(fill, 3)
    local hit = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = ""}, barBg)

    local dragging = false
    local function upd(x)
        local rel = math.clamp((x - barBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / barBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local v = min + (max - min) * rel
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
        val.Text = string.format("%d", math.floor(v))
        callback(v)
    end
    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true; upd(i.Position.X) end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(i.Position.X) end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
    return c
end

local function MakeColorPicker(parent, text, initial, callback)
    local c = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 46), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, parent)
    New("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225,225,230),
        TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, c)
    local swatch = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 2),
        BackgroundColor3 = initial, BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, c); Corner(swatch, 3)

    local row = New("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, c)

    local cur = {R = initial.R * 255, G = initial.G * 255, B = initial.B * 255}
    local function notify()
        local col = Color3.fromRGB(cur.R, cur.G, cur.B)
        swatch.BackgroundColor3 = col
        callback(col)
    end
    for i, ch in ipairs({"R","G","B"}) do
        local chCol = ch == "R" and Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
                   or ch == "G" and Color3.fromRGB(80,255,80)
                   or Color3.fromRGB(80,80,255)
        local bg = New("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -4, 0, 6),
            Position = UDim2.new((i-1)/3, 2, 0.5, -3),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,50), BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, row); Corner(bg, 3)
        local fill = New("Frame", {
            Size = UDim2.new(cur[ch] / 255, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = chCol, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, bg); Corner(fill, 3)
        local hit = New("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = ""}, bg)
        local drg = false
        local function upd(x)
            local rel = math.clamp((x - bg.AbsolutePosition.X) / bg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            cur[ch] = rel * 255
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
            notify()
        end
        hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(ip)
            if ip.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drg = true; upd(ip.Position.X) end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(ip)
            if drg and ip.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(ip.Position.X) end
        end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(ip)
            if ip.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drg = false end
        end)
    end
    return c
end

local ESP = {}
local tracerLines = {}

local function IsValidCharacter(ch)
    if not ch or not ch:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum and hum.Health > 0
end

local function ApplyHighlight(data)
    if not data or not data.highlight then return end
    local h = data.highlight
    h.FillColor           = CFG.ESP.FillColor
    h.FillTransparency    = CFG.ESP.FillEnabled and CFG.ESP.FillTransparency or 1
    h.OutlineColor        = CFG.ESP.OutlineColor
    h.OutlineTransparency = CFG.ESP.OutlineEnabled and CFG.ESP.OutlineTransp or 1
end

local function CreateESP(player)
    if player == LP then return end
    local function onChar(ch)
        if ESP[player] then
            for _, obj in pairs(ESP[player]) do
                if typeof(obj) == "Instance" and obj.Parent then obj:Destroy() end
            end
            if tracerLines[player] then tracerLines[player]:Remove(); tracerLines[player] = nil end
        end

        local hrp  = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        local head = ch:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if not hrp or not head then return end

        local data = {}

        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name      = "TEST_ESP_Fill"
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Adornee   = ch
        hl.Parent    = ch
        data.highlight = hl
        ApplyHighlight(data)

        local bb = New("BillboardGui", {
            Name        = "TEST_ESP_Info",
            Size        = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 34),
            StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0),
            AlwaysOnTop = true,
            Parent      = head,
        })
        data.billboard = bb
        data.nameLabel = New("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.6, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextColor3 = CFG.ESP.NameColor,
            TextStrokeTransparency = 0,
            TextScaled = true,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text = player.Name,
        }, bb)
        data.distLabel = New("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.4, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.6, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextColor3 = CFG.ESP.NameColor,
            TextStrokeTransparency = 0,
            TextScaled = true,
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = "",
        }, bb)

        if Drawing then
            local line = Drawing.new("Line")
            line.Thickness    = 1.5
            line.Transparency = 1 - CFG.ESP.TracerTransp
            line.Color        = CFG.ESP.TracerColor
            line.Visible      = false
            tracerLines[player] = line
            data.tracer = line
        end

        ESP[player] = data

        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.Died:Connect(function()
                if data.highlight then data.highlight.Enabled = false end
                if data.billboard then data.billboard.Enabled = false end
                if data.tracer    then data.tracer.Visible   = false end
            end)
        end
    end

    if player.Character then onChar(player.Character) end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar)
    player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        if tracerLines[player] then tracerLines[player]:Remove(); tracerLines[player] = nil end
        ESP[player] = nil
    end)
end

local function RefreshESPAll()
    for _, data in pairs(ESP) do
        if data.highlight then ApplyHighlight(data) end
        if data.billboard then
            data.billboard.Enabled = CFG.ESP.Enabled and (CFG.ESP.NamesEnabled or CFG.ESP.DistEnabled)
            if data.nameLabel then
                data.nameLabel.Visible    = CFG.ESP.NamesEnabled
                data.nameLabel.TextColor3 = CFG.ESP.NameColor
            end
            if data.distLabel then
                data.distLabel.Visible    = CFG.ESP.DistEnabled
                data.distLabel.TextColor3 = CFG.ESP.NameColor
            end
        end
        if data.tracer then
            data.tracer.Color        = CFG.ESP.TracerColor
            data.tracer.Transparency = 1 - CFG.ESP.TracerTransp
        end
    end
end

-- ================== AIMBOT ==================
local function GetClosestTarget()
    local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
    local best, bestScreenDist = nil, CFG.Aim.FOV

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p == LP then continue end
        local ch = p.Character
        if not IsValidCharacter(ch) then continue end
        local part = ch:FindFirstChild(CFG.Aim.Part)
        if not part then continue end

        local worldDist = (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
        if worldDist > CFG.Aim.MaxDistance then continue end

        local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen then continue end

        local screenDist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
        if screenDist <= bestScreenDist then
            if CFG.Aim.VisibleCheck then
                local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
                local params = RaycastParams.new()
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {ch, LP.Character}
                params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local res = workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, params)
                if res then continue end
            end
            best, bestScreenDist = part, screenDist
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- ================== FLY (тело следует за камерой) ==================
local flyConn = nil
local flyBV   = nil
local flyBG   = nil

local function StopFly()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
    if flyBV and flyBV.Parent then flyBV:Destroy() end
    flyBV = nil
    if flyBG and flyBG.Parent then flyBG:Destroy() end
    flyBG = nil

    local ch = LP.Character
    if ch then
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.PlatformStand = false
            hum.WalkSpeed     = 16
            hum.AutoRotate    = true
            pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
        end
        if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
    end
end

local function StartFly()
    StopFly()
    local ch = LP.Character
    if not ch then return end
    local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    hum.PlatformStand = true
    hum.WalkSpeed     = 0
    hum.AutoRotate    = false
    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)

    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name     = "TEST_FlyBV"
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.P        = 1250
    bv.Parent   = hrp
    flyBV = bv

    local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.Name      = "TEST_FlyBG"
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bg.P         = 30000
    bg.D         = 1000
    bg.CFrame    = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + Camera.CFrame.LookVector)
    bg.Parent    = hrp
    flyBG = bg

    flyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not CFG.Fly.Enabled then return end
        if not hrp.Parent or not bv.Parent or not bg.Parent then StopFly(); return end

        bg.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + Camera.CFrame.LookVector)

        local look  = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local right = Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        local up    = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

        local dir = Vector3.zero
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)         then dir += look  end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)         then dir -= look  end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)         then dir += right end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)         then dir -= right end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)     then dir += up    end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= up    end

        if dir.Magnitude > 0 then
            bv.Velocity = dir.Unit * CFG.Fly.Speed
        else
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = bv.Velocity
    end)
end

LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if CFG.Fly.Enabled then
        task.wait(0.3)
        StartFly()
    end
end)

scripts.code:
--script for my sempai:33

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shooter = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shooter", 20)

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local GEN = (rawget(_G, "ANON_SHOOTER_GEN") or 0) + 1
rawset(_G, "ANON_SHOOTER_GEN", GEN)

local function alive()
    return rawget(_G, "ANON_SHOOTER_GEN") == GEN
end

local S = { gp = false, sb = false, passes = 0, err = "" }
local O = {}
local pass
local tearing = false

local function req(name)
    local inst = Shooter and Shooter:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not inst then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, m = pcall(require, inst)
    if ok and type(m) == "table" then
        return m
    end
    return nil
end

local function find_pass()
    -- the shared ctx table every panel module keeps holds the game's own pass object
    local order = { "MinigunTrial", "WeaponsPanel", "SandboxPanel", "HUD", "SideBar", "MainMenu", "Sandbox", "TracerPass" }
    for _, name in ipairs(order) do
        local m = req(name)
        if m then
            for _, fn in pairs(m) do
                if type(fn) == "function" then
                    for i = 1, 40 do
                        local ok, v = pcall(debug.getupvalue, fn, i)
                        if not ok then
                            break
                        end
                        if type(v) == "table" then
                            local c = rawget(v, "ctx")
                            if type(c) == "table" then
                                local p = rawget(c, "pass")
                                if type(p) == "table" and type(rawget(p, "isOwned")) == "function" then
                                    return p
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function persist()
    if tearing then
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        workspace:SetAttribute("ANON_GP", S.gp)
        workspace:SetAttribute("ANON_SB", S.sb)
    end)
end

local function apply_gp(on)
    pass = pass or find_pass()
    if pass then
        if on then
            if not O.is_owned then
                O.is_owned = pass.isOwned
            end
            pass.isOwned = function()
                return true
            end
        elseif O.is_owned then
            pass.isOwned = O.is_owned
        end
    end

    local gate = req("PassGate")
    if gate then
        if on then
            if not O.gate then
                O.gate = { wait = gate.wait, owned = gate.owned, confirm = gate.confirm }
            end
            gate.wait = function()
                return true
            end
            gate.owned = function()
                return true
            end
            gate.confirm = function()
                return true
            end
        elseif O.gate then
            gate.wait, gate.owned, gate.confirm = O.gate.wait, O.gate.owned, O.gate.confirm
        end
    end

    local tracer = req("TracerPass")
    if tracer and type(tracer.isOwned) == "function" then
        if on then
            if not O.tracer then
                O.tracer = tracer.isOwned
            end
            tracer.isOwned = function()
                return true
            end
        elseif O.tracer then
            tracer.isOwned = O.tracer
        end
    end

    S.gp = on
    S.passes = on and 7 or 0
    persist()
end

local function apply_sb(on)
    local sandbox = req("Sandbox")
    if sandbox then
        pcall(sandbox.forceOwned, on)
        pcall(sandbox.setActive, on)
        S.sb = on and sandbox.active == true
    end
    persist()
end

local COL = {
    bg = Color3.fromRGB(17, 19, 23),
    panel = Color3.fromRGB(25, 28, 34),
    line = Color3.fromRGB(48, 53, 64),
    text = Color3.fromRGB(228, 233, 241),
    dim = Color3.fromRGB(128, 136, 151),
    accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 59, 92),
    on = Color3.fromRGB(61, 220, 132),
    off = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 54),
}
local FONT = Enum.Font.GothamBold
local W = 216
local H_HEAD = 30
local ROW_H = 28
local H_FOOT = 18
local H_OPEN = H_HEAD + ROW_H * 2 + H_FOOT + 8

local gui
local frame
local body
local chevron
local footer
local rows = {}
local open = true

local function label(parent, text, size, color, x, y, w, h)
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = text
    t.Font = FONT
    t.TextSize = size
    t.TextColor3 = color
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    t.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
    t.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
    t.Parent = parent
    return t
end

local function tween(inst, props)
    TweenService:Create(inst, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

local function refresh()
    for key, row in pairs(rows) do
        local on = S[key] == true
        row.track.BackgroundColor3 = on and COL.on or COL.off
        tween(row.knob, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(on and 18 or 3, 3) })
        row.label.TextColor3 = on and COL.text or COL.dim
        row.dot.BackgroundColor3 = on and COL.on or COL.off
    end
    if footer then
        footer.Text = S.gp and ("GAMEPASSES " .. S.passes .. " · SANDBOX " .. (S.sb and "ON" or "OFF")) or "idle"
        footer.TextColor3 = (S.gp or S.sb) and COL.dim or COL.off
    end
    if gui then
        gui:SetAttribute("gp", S.gp)
        gui:SetAttribute("sb", S.sb)
    end
end

local function add_row(y, text, key, setter)
    local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
    row.Name = "row_" .. key
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.AutoButtonColor = false
    row.Text = ""
    row.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, y)
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, ROW_H)
    row.Parent = body

    local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = COL.off
    dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, ROW_H / 2 - 3)
    dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
    dot.Parent = row
    local dot_corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    dot_corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    dot_corner.Parent = dot

    local lab = label(row, text, 11, COL.dim, 14, 0, 130, ROW_H)

    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.BackgroundColor3 = COL.off
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0.5, 0)
    track.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 18)
    track.Parent = row
    local track_corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    track_corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    track_corner.Parent = track

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 240, 246)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    knob.Parent = track
    local knob_corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    knob_corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    knob_corner.Parent = knob

    rows[key] = { label = lab, dot = dot, track = track, knob = knob }

    row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not alive() then
            return
        end
        setter(not S[key])
        refresh()
    end)
end

local drag = { active = false, moved = false, start = Vector2.zero, abs = Vector2.zero }
local dragged = false

local function viewport()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    return cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
end

local function clamp_topleft(pos, size)
    local view = viewport()
    return Vector2.new(
        math.clamp(pos.X, 0, math.max(0, view.X - size.X)),
        math.clamp(pos.Y, 0, math.max(0, view.Y - size.Y))
    )
end

local function set_open(state)
    open = state
    body.Visible = open
    chevron.Text = open and "▾" or "▸"
    local h = open and H_OPEN or H_HEAD
    if dragged then
        local p = clamp_topleft(Vector2.new(frame.Position.X.Offset, frame.Position.Y.Offset), Vector2.new(W, h))
        frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
    end
    tween(frame, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, h) })
end

local function build()
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    for _, c in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("ScreenGui") and c.Name == "ANON_Shooter" then
            c:Destroy()
        end
    end

    gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "ANON_Shooter"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.DisplayOrder = 200
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.Parent = pg

    frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "Panel"
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = COL.panel
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.ClipsDescendants = true
    frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H_OPEN)
    frame.Parent = gui
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    fc.Parent = frame
    local fs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    fs.Color = COL.line
    fs.Thickness = 1
    fs.Parent = frame

    local head = Instance.new("TextButton")
    head.Name = "Head"
    head.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    head.BorderSizePixel = 0
    head.AutoButtonColor = false
    head.Text = ""
    head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, H_HEAD)
    head.Parent = frame

    local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = COL.accent
    dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, H_HEAD / 2 - 3)
    dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
    dot.Parent = head
    local dc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    dc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
    dc.Parent = dot

    label(head, "ANON", 12, COL.text, 22, 0, 100, H_HEAD)

    chevron = label(head, "▾", 12, COL.dim, W - 26, 0, 16, H_HEAD)
    chevron.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

    body = Instance.new("Frame")
    body.Name = "Body"
    body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, H_HEAD)
    body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, ROW_H * 2 + H_FOOT + 8)
    body.Parent = frame

    add_row(0, "ALL GAMEPASSES", "gp", apply_gp)
    add_row(ROW_H, "SANDBOX MODE", "sb", apply_sb)

    footer = label(body, "idle", 10, COL.off, 10, ROW_H * 2 + 2, W - 20, H_FOOT)

    head.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end
        drag.active = true
        drag.moved = false
        drag.start = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        drag.abs = frame.AbsolutePosition
    end)

    head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if drag.moved then
            drag.moved = false
            return
        end
        set_open(not open)
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not drag.active then
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end
        local delta = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - drag.start
        if delta.Magnitude > 4 then
            drag.moved = true
        end
        if drag.moved then
            if not dragged then
                frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
                frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(drag.abs.X, drag.abs.Y)
                dragged = true
            end
            local p = clamp_topleft(drag.abs + delta, frame.AbsoluteSize)
            frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            drag.active = false
        end
    end)
end

local function namecall_hook()
    if STATE and STATE.namecallHook then
        return STATE.namecallHook("UserOwnsGamePassAsync", function()
            if S.gp then
                return true
            end
        end)
    end
    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    local old = mt.__namecall
    setreadonly(mt, false)
    local hooked
    hooked = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        if getnamecallmethod() == "UserOwnsGamePassAsync" and S.gp then
            return true
        end
        return old(self, ...)
    end)
    mt.__namecall = hooked
    setreadonly(mt, true)
    return function()
        setreadonly(mt, false)
        if mt.__namecall == hooked then
            mt.__namecall = old
        end
        setreadonly(mt, true)
    end
end

local function teardown()
    tearing = true
    apply_sb(false)
    apply_gp(false)
    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
        gui = nil
    end
    rawset(getgenv and getgenv() or _G, "ANON_SHOOTER", nil)
end

local function main()
    build()
    namecall_hook()
    refresh()

    local prev_gp = workspace:GetAttribute("ANON_GP") == true
    local prev_sb = workspace:GetAttribute("ANON_SB") == true
    if prev_gp then
        apply_gp(true)
    end
    if prev_sb then
        apply_sb(true)
    end
    refresh()

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then
        cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
            if dragged then
                local p = clamp_topleft(Vector2.new(frame.Position.X.Offset, frame.Position.Y.Offset), frame.AbsoluteSize)
                frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X, p.Y)
            else
                frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            end
        end)
    end

    rawset(getgenv and getgenv() or _G, "ANON_SHOOTER", {
        state = S,
        set_gp = function(on)
            apply_gp(on == true)
            refresh()
        end,
        set_sb = function(on)
            apply_sb(on == true)
            refresh()
        end,
        open = function(state)
            set_open(state ~= false)
        end,
        pass = function()
            return pass
        end,
        teardown = teardown,
    })

    print("[ANON] panel ready · pass=" .. tostring(pass ~= nil))
end

if STATE and STATE.onCleanup then
    STATE.onCleanup(teardown)
end

-- MOVE LABELS
local unwantedMoves = {
	["swift kick"] = true,
	["pebble throw"] = true,
	["elbow drop"] = true
}

local function normalize(text)
	return string.lower((text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end

-- Find the individual move card without hiding the whole panel.
local function findMoveCard(label)
	local candidate = label

	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local parent = candidate.Parent

		if not parent or not parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
			break
		end

		-- Stop before reaching a shared moveset container.
		local otherMoveFound = false

		for _, descendant in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant ~= label and
				(descendant:IsA("TextLabel") or descendant:IsA("TextButton")) then

				local name = normalize(descendant.Text)

				if unwantedMoves[name] or name == "brute force"
					or name == "dropkick" then
					otherMoveFound = true
					break
				end
			end
		end

		if otherMoveFound then
			break
		end

		candidate = parent
	end

	return candidate
end

local function updateMoveset()
	for _, obj in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
			local name = normalize(obj.Text)

			if name == "brute force" then
				obj.Text = "Dropkick"
			elseif unwantedMoves[name] then
				local card = findMoveCard(obj)

				if card and card:IsA("GuiObject") then
					card.Visible = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- ANIMATION
local function stopCurrent()
	if currentTrack then
		pcall(function()
			currentTrack:Stop(0)
			currentTrack:Destroy()
		end)

		currentTrack = nil
	end
end

local function playReplacement(humanoid)
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	if os.clock() - lastAnimationTime < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end

	lastAnimationTime = os.clock()

	stopCurrent()

	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		return
	end

	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. REPLACEMENT_ID

	local success, track = pcall(function()
		return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	end)

	animation:Destroy()

	if not success or not track then
		return
	end

	currentTrack = track
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
	track.Looped = false

	local startingHealth = humanoid.Health
	local cancelled = false

	local damageConnection = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth)
		if newHealth < startingHealth and not cancelled then
			cancelled = true
			stopCurrent()
		end
	end)

	track:Play(0.05)

	task.delay(ANIMATION_DURATION, function()
		if currentTrack == track then
			stopCurrent()
		end

		if damageConnection then
			damageConnection:Disconnect()
		end
	end)
end

local function setupCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")

	stopCurrent()

	animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		if not active or not track.Animation then
			return
		end

		local id = track.Animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")

		if id == ORIGINAL_ID then
			playReplacement(humanoid)
		end
	end)
end

-- ACTIVATE
button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if active then
		return
	end

	active = true
	note:Destroy()

	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(setupCharacter, player.Character)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		task.spawn(setupCharacter, character)
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while active and gui.Parent do
			updateMoveset()
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
	end)
end)

local JumpButton = Instance.new("ImageButton")
JumpButton.Name = "VirtualJump"
JumpButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 75)
JumpButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -120, 1, -130)
JumpButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
JumpButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
JumpButton.Image = "rbxassetid://18244229671"
JumpButton.ImageTransparency = 0.2
JumpButton.Active = true
JumpButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local JumpCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
JumpCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
JumpCorner.Parent = JumpButton

-- Base Lingkaran Joystick
local JoystickBase = Instance.new("Frame")
JoystickBase.Name = "DynamicJoystickBase"
JoystickBase.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 120)
JoystickBase.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
JoystickBase.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
JoystickBase.Visible = false
JoystickBase.Active = false
JoystickBase.Parent = ScreenGui

local BaseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
BaseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
BaseCorner.Parent = JoystickBase

-- Stick Tengah Bulat Kecil
local JoystickStick = Instance.new("ImageButton")
JoystickStick.Name = "Stick"
JoystickStick.Size = UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 55)
JoystickStick.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -27, 0.5, -27)
JoystickStick.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
JoystickStick.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
JoystickStick.Image = "rbxassetid://18244231234"
JoystickStick.Active = false
JoystickStick.Parent = JoystickBase

local StickCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

-- =======================================================================
-- 2. LOGIKA TOMBOL LOMPAT
-- =======================================================================
JumpButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        JumpButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
    end
end)

JumpButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        JumpButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Space, false, game)
    end
end)

-- =======================================================================
-- 3. LOGIKA GERAKAN KOTAK SENSOR (INFINITE DRAG OUT)
-- =======================================================================
local dragging = false
local activeTouchInput = nil
local currentKeys = {W = false, A = false, S = false, D = false}

local function UpdateMovementKeys(newKeys)
    for key, shouldPress in pairs(newKeys) do
        if shouldPress ~= currentKeys[key] then
            currentKeys[key] = shouldPress
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(shouldPress, Enum.KeyCode[key], false, game)
        end
    end
end

local function ProcessJoystickInput(touchPos)
    local center = JoystickBase.AbsolutePosition + (JoystickBase.AbsoluteSize / 2)
    local distance = (touchPos - center)
    local maxRadius = JoystickBase.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    
    if distance.Magnitude > maxRadius then
        distance = distance.Unit * maxRadius
    end
    
    JoystickStick.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, distance.X - 27, 0.5, distance.Y - 27)
    
    local keys = {W = false, A = false, S = false, D = false}
    
    if distance.Magnitude > 8 then
        local dir = distance.Unit
        if dir.Y < -0.38 then keys.W = true end 
        if dir.Y > 0.38 then keys.S = true end  
        if dir.X < -0.38 then keys.A = true end 
        if dir.X > 0.38 then keys.D = true end  
    end
    UpdateMovementKeys(keys)
end

-- Sentuhan harus dimulai dari dalam Kotak Transparan Kiri
TouchZoneBox.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not dragging then
        dragging = true
        activeTouchInput = input
        local pos = input.Position
        
        JoystickBase.Position = UDim2.new(0, pos.X - 60, 0, pos.Y - 60)
        JoystickStick.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -27, 0.5, -27)
        JoystickBase.Visible = true
        
        ProcessJoystickInput(Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y))
    end
end)

-- Menyeret bebas keluar dari batas kotak sensor
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input == activeTouchInput and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        local pos = input.Position
        ProcessJoystickInput(Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y))
    end
end)

-- Jari dilepas di mana saja
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input == activeTouchInput then
        dragging = false
        activeTouchInput = nil
        TweenService:Create(JoystickStick, TweenInfo.new(0.06, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -27, 0.5, -27)}):Play()
        JoystickBase.Visible = false
        UpdateMovementKeys({W = false, A = false, S = false, D = false})
    end
end)

-- =======================================================================
-- 4. LOGIKA INTEGRASI TRIGGERBOT RAYCAST UNIVERSAL (METODE V12 BAKU)
-- =======================================================================
local function GetEnemyInCrosshair()
    local centerScreen = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
    local ray = Camera:ViewportPointToRay(centerScreen.X, centerScreen.Y)
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, ScreenGui}
    
    local result = game:GetService("Workspace"):Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
    
    if result and result.Instance then
        local hitPart = result.Instance
        local humanoid = hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") and hitPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"):FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if not humanoid and hitPart.Parent then
            humanoid = hitPart.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or (hitPart.Parent.Parent and hitPart.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
        end
        
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoid.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

task.spawn(function()
    while getgenv().OneTapTrigger do
        if not sedangMenembak then
            if GetEnemyInCrosshair() then
                sedangMenembak = true
                
                -- Fungsi klik murni andalan dari versi awal Anda yang terbukti menembak
                if mouse1press and mouse1release then
                    mouse1press()
                    task.wait(0.02)
                    mouse1release()
                elseif pressMouseButton1 then
                    pressMouseButton1()
                    task.wait(0.02)
                    releaseMouseButton1()
                end
                
                task.wait(JedaTembak)
                sedangMenembak = false
            end
        end
        task.wait(JedaDeteksi)
    end
end)

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if player:GetAttribute("CrouchSlideLoaded") then return end
player:SetAttribute("CrouchSlideLoaded", true)

local Slide_At = 20
local Crouch_Hip, Slide_Hip, Crouch_Speed = 1.85, 1.3, 0.55
local hitbox_Y, hitbox_Size = 0.5, Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
local crouch_top = hitbox_Y + hitbox_Size.Y * 0.5
local scan_radius = 8
local FLAT_DECEL, UPHILL_DECEL, DOWNHILL_ACCEL = 12, 52, 46

local CROUCH_IMG = "rbxassetid://109660173469064"
local CROUCH_DOWN = "rbxassetid://105987157375274"
local SLIDE_IMG = "rbxassetid://110954069432063"
local SLIDE_DOWN = "rbxassetid://134994664343117"
local ANIMS = {
	idle = "rbxassetid://109602961761132",
	walk = "rbxassetid://134301743319119",
	run = "rbxassetid://77522194791234",
}
local SLIDE_ANIM = "rbxassetid://125545085077300"
local SLIDE_SOUND = "rbxassetid://18952286141"

local State = { Stand = "Stand", Crouch = "Crouch", Slide = "Slide" }

local character, humanoid, hrp, animator
local originalHip, savedSpeed = 2, 16
local collider, colliderWeld
local origCollide, origQuery = {}, {}
local state, crouchOn, slowedSpeed = State.Stand, false, nil
local hipLock = false
local tracks, crouchName, slideTrack, slideSound = {}, nil, nil, nil
local slideDir, slideVel, slideTime, fading = Vector3.zAxis, 0, 0, false
local velocity, attachment, lastToggle = nil, nil, 0
local button, gui
local disabledParts, origPartCollide = {}, {}
local onToggle

local function flatSpeed()
	if not hrp then return 0 end
	local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
end

local function readSpeed()
	if not humanoid or not hrp then return 0 end
	local vel = flatSpeed()
	return humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 and math.max(vel, humanoid.WalkSpeed) or vel
end

local function grounded()
	if not humanoid then return false end
	local s = humanoid:GetState()
	return s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
end

local function usable()
	if not humanoid or not hrp or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	local s = humanoid:GetState()
	return s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead and s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated and s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming and s ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
end

local function rayParams()
	local p = RaycastParams.new()
	p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	p.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	p.RespectCanCollide = true
	return p
end

local function setAttributes()
	if character then
		character:SetAttribute("Crouching", state == State.Crouch)
		character:SetAttribute("Sliding", state == State.Slide)
	end
end

local function syncCollider()
	if colliderWeld and humanoid then
		colliderWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, hitbox_Y - humanoid.HipHeight, 0)
	end
end

local function setPose(hip)
	if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
	local target = hip or originalHip
	if math.abs(humanoid.HipHeight - target) > 0.001 then
		hipLock = true
		humanoid.HipHeight = target
		hipLock = false
	end
	syncCollider()
end

local function restoreOverhang()
	for p in pairs(disabledParts) do
		if p.Parent then p.CanCollide = origPartCollide[p] ~= false end
	end
	disabledParts, origPartCollide = {}, {}
end

local function disableOverhang()
	if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
	local lowerBound = hrp.Position.Y - humanoid.HipHeight + crouch_top + 0.03
	local upperBound = hrp.Position.Y + 3
	for p in pairs(disabledParts) do
		if not p.Parent or (p.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude > scan_radius * 3 then
			if p.Parent then p.CanCollide = origPartCollide[p] ~= false end
			disabledParts[p], origPartCollide[p] = nil, nil
		end
	end
	if upperBound <= lowerBound then return end
	local params = OverlapParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character, workspace.CurrentCamera }
	params.MaxParts = 200
	local ok, parts = pcall(function()
		return workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
			CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, (lowerBound + upperBound) * 0.5, hrp.Position.Z),
			Vector3.new(scan_radius * 2, upperBound - lowerBound, scan_radius * 2),
			params
		)
	end)
	if not ok or not parts then return end
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		if p.Parent and not disabledParts[p] and p.CanCollide and not p:IsDescendantOf(character) then
			local cf, sz = p.CFrame, p.Size
			local lowestY = cf.Position.Y
				- sz.Y * 0.5 * math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)
				- sz.Z * 0.5 * math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)
				- sz.X * 0.5 * math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)
			if lowestY >= lowerBound and lowestY <= upperBound then
				disabledParts[p], origPartCollide[p], p.CanCollide = true, p.CanCollide, false
			end
		end
	end
end

local function disableBody()
	for part in pairs(origCollide) do
		if part.Parent then
			part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery = false, false
		end
	end
	if collider then collider.CanCollide, collider.CanQuery = true, true end
end

local function enableBody()
	for part, orig in pairs(origCollide) do
		if part.Parent then
			part.CanCollide = orig
			part.CanQuery = origQuery[part] ~= false
		end
	end
	if collider then collider.CanCollide, collider.CanQuery = false, false end
end

local function stopCrouch(fade)
	for _, track in pairs(tracks) do
		if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(fade or 0.15) end
	end
	crouchName = nil
end

local function playCrouch(name)
	local track = tracks[name]
	if not track then return end
	if crouchName ~= name then
		for n, other in pairs(tracks) do
			if n ~= name and other.IsPlaying then other:Stop(0.15) end
		end
		track:Play(0.15, 1, 1)
		crouchName = name
	end
	local speed = flatSpeed()
	track:AdjustSpeed(name == "walk" and math.clamp(speed / 8, 0.65, 1.5) or name == "run" and math.clamp(speed / 18, 0.75, 1.45) or 1)
end

local function updateCrouchAnim()
	if state ~= State.Crouch then return end
	local speed = flatSpeed()
	playCrouch(speed < 0.75 and "idle" or speed < 16 and "walk" or "run")
end

local function loadTracks()
	tracks, crouchName, slideTrack = {}, nil, nil
	if not animator then return end
	for name, id in pairs(ANIMS) do
		local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
		anim.AnimationId = id
		local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
		if ok and track then
			track.Priority, track.Looped, tracks[name] = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement, true, track
		end
	end
	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = SLIDE_ANIM
	local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
	if ok and track then
		track.Priority, track.Looped, slideTrack = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4, true, track
	end
end

local function freezeSlide()
	if not slideTrack or not slideTrack.IsPlaying or slideTrack.Length <= 0.05 then return end
	local at = math.min(0.6, math.max(slideTrack.Length - 0.04, 0))
	if slideTrack.TimePosition >= at then
		slideTrack.TimePosition = at
		if slideTrack.Speed ~= 0 then slideTrack:AdjustSpeed(0) end
	end
end

local function startSound()
	if not hrp then return end
	if slideSound then slideSound:Destroy() end
	slideSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	slideSound.Name, slideSound.SoundId, slideSound.Looped, slideSound.Volume = "SlideLoop", SLIDE_SOUND, true, 0.6
	slideSound.RollOffMode, slideSound.RollOffMaxDistance = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear, 70
	slideSound.Parent = hrp
	slideSound:Play()
end

local function stopSound(fade)
	local s = slideSound
	slideSound = nil
	if not s then return end
	if fade and s.Parent then
		local tw = TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.22), { Volume = 0 })
		tw:Play()
		tw.Completed:Connect(function() s:Stop(); s:Destroy() end)
	else
		s:Stop(); s:Destroy()
	end
end

local function clearMover()
	if velocity then velocity:Destroy(); velocity = nil end
	if attachment then attachment:Destroy(); attachment = nil end
end

local function findJump()
	local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	local touch = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
	local frame = touch and touch:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
	return frame and frame:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
end

local function refreshButton()
	if not button then return end
	local pressed = state == State.Crouch or (state == State.Slide and crouchOn)
	local sliding = state == State.Slide or (state ~= State.Crouch and readSpeed() >= Slide_At)
	button.Image = sliding and (pressed and SLIDE_DOWN or SLIDE_IMG) or (pressed and CROUCH_DOWN or CROUCH_IMG)
end

local function layoutButton()
	if not button or not gui then return end
	local jump = findJump()
	button.Visible = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and jump ~= nil
	if not button.Visible then return end
	local pos, size = jump.AbsolutePosition, jump.AbsoluteSize
	if size.X < 2 then return end
	button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)
	button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X - gui.AbsolutePosition.X - math.max(8, size.X * 0.18), pos.Y - gui.AbsolutePosition.Y + size.Y * 0.5)
end

local function ensureGui()
	if gui and gui.Parent then return end
	gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "CrouchSlideGui", false, true, 50
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
	button.Name = "CrouchButton"
	button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	button.BackgroundTransparency, button.AutoButtonColor = 1, false
	button.ScaleType, button.Image = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, CROUCH_IMG
	button.Size, button.Visible, button.ZIndex = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 70), false, 10
	button.Parent = gui
	button.Activated:Connect(function() onToggle() end)
end

local function facing()
	if not humanoid or not hrp then return Vector3.zAxis end
	local flat = Vector3.new(humanoid.MoveDirection.X, 0, humanoid.MoveDirection.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then return flat.Unit end
	local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	flat = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 2 then return flat.Unit end
	flat = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	return flat.Magnitude > 0.05 and flat.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
end

local function slope()
	if not hrp then return 0 end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), rayParams())
	return hit and math.clamp(hit.Normal:Dot(slideDir), -1, 1) or 0
end

local function steerSlide(dt)
	local wish = humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
	local flat = Vector3.new(wish.X, 0, wish.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.12 then
		local keys = (UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left)) and -1 or 0
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then keys += 1 end
		if keys == 0 then return end
		local right = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector or Vector3.xAxis
		flat = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
		flat = flat.Unit * keys
	end
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
	local blended = slideDir:Lerp(flat.Unit, 1 - math.exp(-5.5 * math.clamp(flat.Magnitude, 0, 1) * dt))
	if blended.Magnitude > 0.01 then slideDir = blended.Unit end
end

local function hitWall()
	if not hrp then return false end
	local dist = math.clamp(1.6 + slideVel * 0.05, 1.8, 4.5)
	for _, y in ipairs({ 0.2, 1.3, 2.2 }) do
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, y, 0), slideDir * dist, rayParams())
		if hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance.CanCollide and hit.Normal.Y < 0.45 then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function beginFade()
	if fading then return end
	fading = true
	if crouchOn then
		setPose(Crouch_Hip)
		if slideTrack and slideTrack.IsPlaying then slideTrack:Stop(0.22) end
		playCrouch(flatSpeed() >= 16 and "run" or flatSpeed() >= 0.75 and "walk" or "idle")
	else
		setPose(nil)
		if slideTrack and slideTrack.IsPlaying then slideTrack:Stop(0.22) end
		stopCrouch(0.18)
	end
	stopSound(true)
end

local function finishSlide(wall)
	if state ~= State.Slide then return end
	local keep = crouchOn and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
	if not fading then beginFade() end
	clearMover()
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
		if wall and hrp then
			local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, v.Y, 0)
		end
		if keep then
			state = State.Crouch
			setPose(Crouch_Hip)
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = math.max(6, savedSpeed * Crouch_Speed)
			slowedSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
			disableBody()
		else
			state, crouchOn = State.Stand, false
			humanoid.WalkSpeed, slowedSpeed = savedSpeed, nil
			setPose(nil)
			stopCrouch(0.16)
			enableBody()
			restoreOverhang()
		end
	else
		state, crouchOn = State.Stand, false
		enableBody()
		restoreOverhang()
	end
	fading = false
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
end

local function startSlide(speed)
	savedSpeed, slideDir = humanoid.WalkSpeed, facing()
	slideVel = math.clamp(math.max(speed, flatSpeed(), Slide_At) * 1.5, 24, 100)
	slideTime, fading, state, crouchOn = 0, false, State.Slide, true
	stopCrouch(0.06)
	setPose(Slide_Hip)
	disableBody()
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
	local y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(slideDir.X * slideVel, y, slideDir.Z * slideVel)
	hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + slideDir)
	clearMover()
	attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = hrp
	velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	velocity.Attachment0 = attachment
	velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	velocity.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
	velocity.MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 0, 1e5)
	velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(slideDir.X * slideVel, 0, slideDir.Z * slideVel)
	velocity.Parent = hrp
	if slideTrack then slideTrack:Play(0.08, 1, 1); slideTrack:AdjustSpeed(1) end
	startSound()
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
end

local function enterCrouch()
	if state == State.Stand then savedSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed end
	state, crouchOn = State.Crouch, true
	setPose(Crouch_Hip)
	disableBody()
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = math.max(6, savedSpeed * Crouch_Speed)
	slowedSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
	updateCrouchAnim()
end

local function exitCrouch()
	state, crouchOn = State.Stand, false
	stopCrouch(0.15)
	setPose(nil)
	enableBody()
	restoreOverhang()
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		if slowedSpeed and math.abs(humanoid.WalkSpeed - slowedSpeed) < 0.4 then humanoid.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed end
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
	end
	slowedSpeed = nil
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
end

onToggle = function()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastToggle < 0.1 then return end
	lastToggle = now
	if not usable() then return end
	if state == State.Slide then
		crouchOn = false
		finishSlide(true)
	elseif state == State.Crouch then
		exitCrouch()
	elseif grounded() then
		local speed = readSpeed()
		if speed >= Slide_At then startSlide(speed) else enterCrouch() end
	end
end

local function updateSlide(dt)
	if state ~= State.Slide or not humanoid or not hrp or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		if state == State.Slide then crouchOn = false; finishSlide(false) end
		return
	end
	if slideTime > 0.18 and flatSpeed() < 4 and slideVel > 12 then finishSlide(true); return end
	slideTime += dt
	steerSlide(dt)
	local grade = slope()
	slideVel = math.clamp(slideVel + ((grade > 0.03 and grade * DOWNHILL_ACCEL or 0) - (FLAT_DECEL + (grade < -0.03 and -grade * UPHILL_DECEL or 0))) * dt, 0, 110)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.AutoRotate = 0, false
	if velocity then velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(slideDir.X * slideVel, 0, slideDir.Z * slideVel) end
	local y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + slideDir)
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(slideDir.X * slideVel, y, slideDir.Z * slideVel)
	if hitWall() then finishSlide(true); return end
	if not fading and slideVel < 11 then beginFade() end
	if (slideTime > 0.35 and slideVel <= 5) or slideTime >= 7 then finishSlide(false) end
end

local function destroyCollider()
	if collider then collider:Destroy(); collider = nil end
	colliderWeld, origCollide, origQuery = nil, {}, {}
end

local function createCollider(char, root)
	collider = Instance.new("Part")
	collider.Name, collider.Size, collider.Transparency = "LowHitbox", hitbox_Size, 1
	collider.CanCollide, collider.CanQuery, collider.CanTouch, collider.Massless = false, false, false, true
	collider.Parent = char
	colliderWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
	colliderWeld.Part0, colliderWeld.Part1 = root, collider
	colliderWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, hitbox_Y - (humanoid and humanoid.HipHeight or originalHip), 0)
	colliderWeld.Parent = collider
	origCollide, origQuery = {}, {}
	for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= root and d ~= collider then
			origCollide[d], origQuery[d] = d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery
		end
	end
end

local function teardown()
	clearMover()
	stopSound(false)
	stopCrouch(0)
	if slideTrack and slideTrack.IsPlaying then slideTrack:Stop(0) end
	enableBody()
	restoreOverhang()
	destroyCollider()
	if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		pcall(function()
			hipLock = true
			humanoid.HipHeight = originalHip
			hipLock = false
			humanoid.AutoRotate = true
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
			if slowedSpeed and math.abs(humanoid.WalkSpeed - slowedSpeed) < 0.4 then humanoid.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed end
		end)
	end
	state, crouchOn, fading, slowedSpeed, tracks, slideTrack = State.Stand, false, false, nil, {}, nil
end

local function setup(char)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not hum or not root or player.Character ~= char then return end
	char:WaitForChild("Animate", 5)
	task.wait(0.15)
	if player.Character ~= char or not hum.Parent then return end
	teardown()
	character, humanoid, hrp = char, hum, root
	animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	originalHip = hum.HipHeight > 0.05 and hum.HipHeight or 2
	savedSpeed, state, crouchOn = hum.WalkSpeed, State.Stand, false
	loadTracks()
	createCollider(char, root)
	syncCollider()
	setAttributes()
	refreshButton()
	char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= collider and d ~= root and origCollide[d] == nil then
			origCollide[d], origQuery[d] = d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery
			if state ~= State.Stand then d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery = false, false end
		end
	end)
	hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("HipHeight"):Connect(function()
		if not hipLock and humanoid then syncCollider() end
	end)
	hum.Died:Connect(function()
		if character ~= char then return end
		crouchOn = false
		if state == State.Slide then finishSlide(false) end
		teardown()
	end)
	hum.Jumping:Connect(function(active)
		if character == char and active and state == State.Crouch then exitCrouch() end
	end)
	hum.Seated:Connect(function(active)
		if character ~= char or not active or state == State.Stand then return end
		crouchOn = false
		if state == State.Slide then finishSlide(false) end
		if state == State.Crouch then exitCrouch() end
	end)
end

scripts.summary: Roblox god mode script by me
scripts.code:
-- god_mode.lua — roblox
-- works in most executors (synapse, krnl, fluxus, etc.)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function godMode()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end

    -- kill the health link so damage can't propagate
    hum.Health = math.huge
    hum.MaxHealth = math.huge

    -- strip the damage listener if one exists
    for _, conn in pairs(getconnections(hum.HealthChanged)) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end

    -- keep it pinned in case something rewrites it
    if not char:FindFirstChild("_godLoop") then
        local loop = Instance.new("BoolValue")
        loop.Name = "_godLoop"
        loop.Parent = char

        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not char.Parent then return end
            local h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if h then
                h.Health = math.huge
                h.MaxHealth = math.huge
            end
        end)
    end

    -- block the ragdoll/fall-damage path
    pcall(function()
        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
        hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
    end)

    -- noclip assist so terrain doesn't cheese you
    local noclip = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if char then
            for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
        noclip:Disconnect()
    end)
end

-- run on spawn and on respawn
godMode()
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    godMode()
end)

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function setupCharacter(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://72722244508749"
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)

    screenGui:ClearAllChildren()

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = screenGui
    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true

    local playBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    playBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    playBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    playBtn.Text = "Play Animation"
    playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 180)
    playBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    playBtn.Parent = frame

    playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        animTrack:Play()
    end)

    local keybindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    keybindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
    keybindBtn.Text = currentKey and ("Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")") or "Set Keybind (Current: none)"

    keybindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    keybindBtn.TextScaled = true
    keybindBtn.Parent = frame

    local waitingForKey = false

    keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        keybindBtn.Text = "Press a key..."
        waitingForKey = true
    end)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)

            animTrack:Play()
        end
    end)

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end
