Section3:Button({
   Text = "Aim",
   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end
})

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

                end

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
                if openFlag and openFlag.Value then
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                else
                    local openSafe = item:FindFirstChild("OpenSafe")
                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)

        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

Queue.__index = Queue
function Queue.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self
end

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

function Queue:IsEmpty()
    return #self.elements == 0
end
function Queue:Current()
    return self.elements
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

    hex = tostring(hex)
    local text = ""

        text = text .. string.char(byte)

 local key = ''
 local a = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
 for i = 1, optionalSize or 32 do local n = math.random(1, #a) key = key .. a:sub(n, n) end

end

funcs.crypt.encrypt = function(a, b)
 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end
 return table.concat(result)
end

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')
 local CurrentPath = {}
 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]
  elseif i == #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
 end
end

funcs.loadfile = function(path)
 local content = funcs.readfile(path)
 if not content then error('File \'' .. tostring(path) .. '\' does not exist.') return '' end
 local s, func = pcall(function()
  return loadstring(content)
 end)
 return func, not s and func or nil
end

 if type(f) == 'table' then files[path] = nil end
end
funcs.delfile = function(path)

funcs.listfiles = function(path)
    if not path or path == '' then
     local Files = {}
     for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if #i:split('/') == 1 then table.insert(Files, i) end
     end
     return Files
    end
    if type(files[path]) ~= 'table' then return error(path .. ' is not a folder.') end
    local Files = {}
    for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if startswith(i, path .. '/') and not endswith(i, '/') and i ~= path and #i:split('/') == (#path:split('/') + 1) then table.insert(Files, i) end
    end
    return Files
end

funcs.Drawing.new = function(Type) -- Drawing.new
    local baseProps = {
     Visible = false,
     Color = Color3.new(0,0,0),
     ClassName = nil
    }
    if Type == 'Line' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            From = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            To = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateLine = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             local from = self.From
             local to = self.To
             local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
             local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y - from.Y, to.X - from.X))

             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, self.Thickness)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, from.X, 0, from.Y)
             a.Rotation = angle
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Size = UDim2.new(0, (self.To - self.From).Magnitude, 0, value)
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' and value <= 1 then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'From' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            elseif key == 'To' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Square' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", DrawingDict)
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local b = Instance.new("UIStroke", a)
        b.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        b.Enabled = true

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Size = Vector2.new(0,0),
            Position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateSquare = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Size.X, 0, self.Size.Y)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Filled' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                b.Enabled = not value
                a.BackgroundTransparency = value and 0 or 1
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
                b.Color = value
            elseif key == 'Position' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateSquare()
            elseif key == 'Size' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateSquare()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Circle' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local b = Instance.new("UIStroke", a)
        b.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        b.Enabled = false
        b.Thickness = 1
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner", a)
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            Filled = false,
            NumSides = 0,
            Radius = 1,
            Position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateCircle = function(self)
             if not b or not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Radius, 0, self.Radius)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
             b.Enabled = not self
             b.Color = self.Color
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                b.Thickness = value
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
                a.Color = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value

                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateCircle()
            elseif key == 'Radius' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateCircle()

             a.TextScaled = true

             a.TextColor3 = self.Color

             a.BorderSizePixel = self.Outline and 1 or 0

              a.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
             else

              a.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
             end
             a.TextStrokeTransparency = self.Outline and 0 or 1
             a.TextStrokeColor3 = self.OutlineColor
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end

function DecompileScript(Script)
    local Decompiled = "--[[ DECOMPILED WITH SIMPLEDECOMPILE ]]\n"
    if typeof(Script) == "Instance" and Script.ClassName == "ModuleScript" then
        local s, e =
            pcall(
            function()
                for i, v in require(Script) do
                    if type(v) == "table" then
                        if #v == 0 then
                            if type(i) == "number" then
                                Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal table_%d = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(pKey1(i, v))
                            else
                                Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal %s = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(i)
                            end
                        else
                            if type(i) == "number" then
                                Decompiled =
                                    Decompiled ..
                                    ("local table_%d = {\n%s};\n"):format(
                                        pKey1(i, v),
                                        processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i))
                                    )
                            else
                                Decompiled =
                                    Decompiled ..
                                    ("local %s = {\n%s};\n"):format(
                                        i,
                                        processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i))
                                    )
                            end
                        end
                elseif type(v) == 'function' then
                 if type(i) == 'number' then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0, "f_"..tostring(i)))
                 else
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0))
                 end
                end
             end
            end
        )
        if not s then
            return "-- Error occured when trying to iterate over ModuleScript, Message: " .. e
        end
        return Decompiled
    end
    local s, e =
        pcall(
        function()
            local uks = 1
            for i, v in getsenv(Script) do
                if type(v) == "table" then
                    if #v == 0 then
                        if type(i) == "number" then
                            Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal table_%d = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(pKey1(i, v))
                        else
                            Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\nlocal %s = {}; --[[ EMPTY TABLE ]]\n"):format(i)
                        end
                    else
                        if type(i) == "number" then
                            Decompiled =
                                Decompiled ..
                                ("local table_%d = {\n%s};"):format(
                                    pKey1(i, v),
                                    processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i))
                                )
                        else
                            Decompiled =
                                Decompiled ..
                                ("local %s = {\n%s};\n"):format(i, processTableDescendants(v, 0, "t_" .. tostring(i)))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for i, v in gcsenv(Script) do -- garbage collection senv
                local name = debug.getinfo(v).name
                if name == nil and Settings.IncludeNils then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0, "nil" .. tostring(uks)))
                    uks = uks + 1
                elseif name ~= nil then
                    Decompiled = Decompiled .. ("\n%s"):format(DecompileFunction(v, false, 0))
                end
            end
        end
    )
    if not s then
        return " --An error occured while attempting to iterate over Script's enviroment!\nMessage: " .. e
    end
    return Decompiled
end

getgenv().decompile = DecompileScript
return DecompileScript

local function setupSlider(parent, labelText, yPos, minVal, maxVal, startVal, onUpdate)
    local lbl = makeLabel(parent, labelText, yPos)
    local slider = Instance.new("Frame")
    slider.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14)
    slider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos + 18)
    slider.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderBg
    slider.BorderSizePixel = 0
    slider.ZIndex = 12
    slider.Parent = parent

    local sliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    sliderCorner.Parent = slider

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    local startRelX = (startVal - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(startRelX, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = 13
    fill.Parent = slider
    local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
    fillCorner.Parent = fill

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(startRelX, -6, 0.5, -6)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Text
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 14
    knob.Parent = slider
    local knobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    knobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    knobCorner.Parent = knob

    local isDragging = false
    local function update(inputPos)
        local relX = math.clamp((inputPos.X - slider.AbsolutePosition.X) / slider.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local value = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * relX
        TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.06), { Size = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1, 0) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.06), { Position = UDim2.new(relX, -6, 0.5, -6) }):Play()
        onUpdate(value)
    end
    slider.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isDragging = true; update(input.Position)
        end
    end)
    slider.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then isDragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then update(input.Position) end
    end)
    return lbl
end

local function startFly()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.Parent = hrp
    flyBodyVelocity = bv
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flyBodyVelocity then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveVec = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveVec += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveVec -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveVec -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveVec += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveVec += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then moveVec -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if moveVec.Magnitude > 0 then moveVec = moveVec.Unit * currentFlySpeed end
        flyBodyVelocity.Velocity = moveVec
    end)
end

    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect(); flyConnection = nil end
    if flyBodyVelocity then flyBodyVelocity:Destroy(); flyBodyVelocity = nil end

-- ============================================================
-- FARM LOGIC (С СИСТЕМОЙ ПРОПУСКА И БЕЗ +5)
-- ============================================================
local farmOrbsActive = false
local farmXpActive = false

-- Черный список (запоминает объекты, к которым нельзя телепортироваться)
local skipList = {}

-- Очистка черного списка (если в нем больше 50 объектов или все орбы в нем)
local function clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local count = 0
    for _ in pairs(skipList) do count = count + 1 end
    if count > 50 then
        skipList = {}
    end
end

-- Проверка, можно ли телепортироваться к объекту (он существует, он в Workspace, его не удалили)
local function isValidOrb(part)
    if not part or not part.Parent then return false end
    if skipList[part] then return false end
    return true
end

-- Поиск SandOrb / VoidOrb
local function findSandVoidOrb()
    clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local orbs = {}
    
    local voidFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("VoidOrbs")
    if voidFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(voidFolder:GetChildren()) do
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part and isValidOrb(part) then table.insert(orbs, part) end
        end
    end
    
    local sandFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("SandOrbs")
    if sandFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(sandFolder:GetChildren()) do
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part and isValidOrb(part) then table.insert(orbs, part) end
        end
    end
    
    if #orbs > 0 then return orbs[1] end
    
    -- Если все орбы в черном списке, чистим его
    if #orbs == 0 and next(skipList) then
        skipList = {}
        return findSandVoidOrb()
    end
    
    return nil
end

-- Поиск Розового Orb (цвет 255, 110, 220)
local function findPinkOrb()
    clearSkipListIfNeeded()
    local orbs = {}
    local orbsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Orbs")
    if orbsFolder then
        for _, obj in ipairs(orbsFolder:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name == "Orb" then
                local c = obj.Color
                if math.abs(c.R * 255 - 255) < 5 and math.abs(c.G * 255 - 110) < 5 and math.abs(c.B * 255 - 220) < 5 then
                    if isValidOrb(obj) then table.insert(orbs, obj) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    if #orbs > 0 then return orbs[1] end
    
    if #orbs == 0 and next(skipList) then
        skipList = {}
        return findPinkOrb()
    end
    
    return nil
end

-- Универсальный телепорт (Y = 0, ровно в центр)
local function teleportTo(part)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp and part then
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position) -- Смещение 0, ровно в центр
        return true
    end
    return false
end

-- ESP
-- ============================================================
local espEnabled = false
local espRunning = false
local espThread = nil

local function startEsp()
    if espRunning then return end
    espRunning = true
    espThread = task.spawn(function()
        _G.FriendColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
        _G.EnemyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        _G.UseTeamColor = true

        local Holder = Instance.new("Folder", game.CoreGui)
        Holder.Name = "ESP"

        local Box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
        Box.Name = "nilBox"
        Box.Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
        Box.Color3 = Color3.new(100 / 255, 100 / 255, 100 / 255)
        Box.Transparency = 0.7
        Box.ZIndex = 0
        Box.AlwaysOnTop = false
        Box.Visible = false

        local NameTag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        NameTag.Name = "nilNameTag"
        NameTag.Enabled = false
        NameTag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
        NameTag.AlwaysOnTop = true
        NameTag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0)
        local Tag = Instance.new("TextLabel", NameTag)
        Tag.Name = "Tag"
        Tag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Tag.Position = UDim2.new(0, -50, 0, 0)
        Tag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 20)
        Tag.TextSize = 15
        Tag.TextColor3 = Color3.new(100 / 255, 100 / 255, 100 / 255)
        Tag.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0 / 255, 0 / 255, 0 / 255)
        Tag.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        Tag.Text = "nil"
        Tag.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        Tag.TextScaled = false

        local LoadCharacter = function(v)
            repeat task.wait() until v.Character ~= nil
            v.Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
            local vHolder = Holder:FindFirstChild(v.Name)
            if not vHolder then return end
            vHolder:ClearAllChildren()
            local b = Box:Clone()
            b.Name = v.Name .. "Box"
            b.Adornee = v.Character
            b.Parent = vHolder
            local t = NameTag:Clone()
            t.Name = v.Name .. "NameTag"
            t.Enabled = true
            t.Parent = vHolder
            t.Adornee = v.Character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
            if not t.Adornee then
                return UnloadCharacter(v)
            end
            t.Tag.Text = v.Name
            b.Color3 = Color3.new(v.TeamColor.r, v.TeamColor.g, v.TeamColor.b)
            t.Tag.TextColor3 = Color3.new(v.TeamColor.r, v.TeamColor.g, v.TeamColor.b)
            local Update
            local UpdateNameTag = function()
                if not pcall(function()
                    v.Character.Humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                end) then
                    if Update then Update:Disconnect() end
                end
            end
            UpdateNameTag()
            Update = v.Character.Humanoid.Changed:Connect(UpdateNameTag)
        end

        local UnloadCharacter = function(v)
            local vHolder = Holder:FindFirstChild(v.Name)
            if vHolder and (vHolder:FindFirstChild(v.Name .. "Box") ~= nil or vHolder:FindFirstChild(v.Name .. "NameTag") ~= nil) then
                vHolder:ClearAllChildren()
            end
        end

        local LoadPlayer = function(v)
            local vHolder = Instance.new("Folder", Holder)
            vHolder.Name = v.Name
            v.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                pcall(LoadCharacter, v)
            end)
            v.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
                pcall(UnloadCharacter, v)
            end)
            v.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
                if prop == "TeamColor" then
                    UnloadCharacter(v)
                    task.wait()
                    LoadCharacter(v)
                end
            end)
            LoadCharacter(v)
        end

        local UnloadPlayer = function(v)
            UnloadCharacter(v)
            local vHolder = Holder:FindFirstChild(v.Name)
            if vHolder then
                vHolder:Destroy()
            end
        end

        for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
            task.spawn(function() pcall(LoadPlayer, v) end)
        end

        game:GetService("Players").PlayerAdded:Connect(function(v)
            pcall(LoadPlayer, v)
        end)

        game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(v)
            pcall(UnloadPlayer, v)
        end)

        game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.NameDisplayDistance = 0

        if _G.Reantheajfdfjdgs then
            return
        end

        _G.Reantheajfdfjdgs = ":suifayhgvsdghfsfkajewfrhk321rk213kjrgkhj432rj34f67df"

        local players = game:GetService("Players")
        local plr = players.LocalPlayer

        function esp(target, color)
            if target.Character then
                if not target.Character:FindFirstChild("GetReal") then
                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.RobloxLocked = true
                    highlight.Name = "GetReal"
                    highlight.Adornee = target.Character
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.FillColor = color
                    highlight.Parent = target.Character
                else
                    target.Character.GetReal.FillColor = color
                end
            end
        end

        while espRunning do
            task.wait(1)
            for i, v in pairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                if v ~= plr then
                    esp(v, _G.UseTeamColor and v.TeamColor.Color or ((plr.TeamColor == v.TeamColor) and _G.FriendColor or _G.EnemyColor))
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function stopEsp()
    espRunning = false
    if espThread then
        task.cancel(espThread)
        espThread = nil
    end
    local espFolder = game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ESP")
    if espFolder then
        espFolder:Destroy()
    end
end

    espBtn.Text = "Player ESP: " .. (espEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")
    if espEnabled then

    else
        stopEsp()
    end
end)

scripts.code:
-- [[ Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

-- [[ End Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

if _G.SoundHub_Cleanup then
	pcall(_G.SoundHub_Cleanup)
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local connections = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
	local c = signal:Connect(fn)
	table.insert(connections, c)
	return c
end

local THEME = {
	Window = Color3.fromRGB(118, 114, 108),
	WindowTop = Color3.fromRGB(152, 148, 142),
	WindowBottom = Color3.fromRGB(94, 90, 85),
	White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	Inset = Color3.fromRGB(58, 55, 51),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	SubText = Color3.fromRGB(228, 225, 219),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(10, 132, 255),
	Green = Color3.fromRGB(48, 209, 88),
	Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 69, 58),
	Orange = Color3.fromRGB(255, 159, 10),
	Off = Color3.fromRGB(142, 142, 147),
}

local FONT = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
local FONT_BOLD = Enum.Font.GothamBold
local LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

local FILES = {
	playlist = "SoundHub_Playlist.json",
	favorites = "SoundHub_Favorites.json",
	recent = "SoundHub_Recent.json",
	preset = "SoundHub_Preset.json",
	config = "SoundHub_Config.json",
}

local CFG = {
	masterVolume = 0.6,
	playbackSpeed = 1,
	fadeTime = 0.5,
	soundMode = "2D",
	autoNext = true,
	shuffle = false,
	repeatMode = "off",
	uiKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
}

local playlist, favorites, recent, customPreset = {}, {}, {}, {}

local notify, refreshNowPlaying, cleanup
local renderPlaylist, renderFavorites, renderRecent, renderCustom
local onEnded, playFromQueue
local playlistList, favoritesList, recentList, customList, searchList

local hasFS = type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function"

local function writeJson(name, data)
	if not hasFS then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		writefile(name, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
	end)
end

local function readJson(name)
	if not hasFS then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		if isfile(name) then
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(name))
		end
		return nil
	end)
	if ok then
		return result
	end
	return nil
end

local function idStr(value)
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return string.format("%.0f", value)
	end
	return tostring(value)
end

local function cleanList(raw)
	local out = {}
	if type(raw) == "table" then
		for _, v in ipairs(raw) do
			if type(v) == "table" and v.id then
				local id = idStr(v.id)
				table.insert(out, { id = id, name = tostring(v.name or ("Audio " .. id)) })
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function cfgToTable()
	return {
		masterVolume = CFG.masterVolume,
		playbackSpeed = CFG.playbackSpeed,
		fadeTime = CFG.fadeTime,
		soundMode = CFG.soundMode,
		autoNext = CFG.autoNext,
		shuffle = CFG.shuffle,
		repeatMode = CFG.repeatMode,
		uiKey = CFG.uiKey.Name,
	}
end

local function cfgFromTable(t)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if type(t.masterVolume) == "number" then
		CFG.masterVolume = math.clamp(t.masterVolume, 0, 1)
	end
	if type(t.playbackSpeed) == "number" then
		CFG.playbackSpeed = math.clamp(t.playbackSpeed, 0.5, 2)
	end
	if type(t.fadeTime) == "number" then
		CFG.fadeTime = math.clamp(t.fadeTime, 0, 3)
	end
	if t.soundMode == "2D" or t.soundMode == "3D" then
		CFG.soundMode = t.soundMode
	end
	if type(t.autoNext) == "boolean" then
		CFG.autoNext = t.autoNext
	end
	if type(t.shuffle) == "boolean" then
		CFG.shuffle = t.shuffle
	end
	if t.repeatMode == "off" or t.repeatMode == "all" or t.repeatMode == "one" then
		CFG.repeatMode = t.repeatMode
	end
	if type(t.uiKey) == "string" then
		local ok, key = pcall(function()
			return Enum.KeyCode[t.uiKey]
		end)
		if ok and key then
			CFG.uiKey = key
		end
	end
end

local function savePlaylist()
	writeJson(FILES.playlist, playlist)
end
local function saveFavorites()
	writeJson(FILES.favorites, favorites)
end
local function saveRecent()
	writeJson(FILES.recent, recent)
end
local function savePreset()
	writeJson(FILES.preset, customPreset)
end
local function saveConfig()
	writeJson(FILES.config, cfgToTable())
end
local function saveAll()
	savePlaylist()
	saveFavorites()
	saveRecent()
	savePreset()
	saveConfig()
end

local function loadAll()
	playlist = cleanList(readJson(FILES.playlist))
	favorites = cleanList(readJson(FILES.favorites))
	recent = cleanList(readJson(FILES.recent))
	customPreset = cleanList(readJson(FILES.preset))
	cfgFromTable(readJson(FILES.config))
end

loadAll()

local function renderAll()
	if renderPlaylist then
		renderPlaylist()
	end
	if renderFavorites then
		renderFavorites()
	end
	if renderRecent then
		renderRecent()
	end
	if renderCustom then
		renderCustom()
	end
end

local function copyText(text)
	local fn = setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard
	if fn then
		local ok = pcall(fn, text)
		return ok
	end
	return false
end

local function copyId(id)
	if copyText(tostring(id)) then
		notify("Copied ID " .. tostring(id), THEME.Green)
	else
		notify("Clipboard is not supported by your executor", THEME.Red)
	end
end

local function hasTrack(list, id)
	for i, t in ipairs(list) do
		if t.id == id then
			return i
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function addUnique(list, track)
	if hasTrack(list, track.id) then
		return false
	end
	table.insert(list, { id = track.id, name = track.name })
	return true
end

local function httpGet(url)
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)
	if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 0 then
		return true, res
	end
	local req = (syn and syn.request) or http_request or request
	if req then
		local ok2, r = pcall(req, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
		if ok2 and r then
			if r.StatusCode == 200 and r.Body then
				return true, r.Body
			end
			return false, "HTTP " .. tostring(r.StatusCode)
		end
		return false, tostring(r)
	end
	return false, tostring(res)
end

local function extractItems(data)
	local list = data.data or data.creatorStoreAssets or data.assets or data.items or data
	local out = {}
	if type(list) ~= "table" then
		return out
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do
		if type(e) == "table" then
			local a = e.asset or e.assetInfo or e
			local rawId = a.id or a.assetId or e.id
			if rawId then
				local typeId = a.typeId or a.assetTypeId or a.assetType
				if typeId == nil or typeId == 3 or typeId == "Audio" then
					table.insert(out, { id = idStr(rawId), name = a.name or e.name })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

local function fetchNames(ids)
	local map = {}
	local i = 1
	while i <= #ids do
		local batch = {}
		for j = i, math.min(i + 29, #ids) do
			table.insert(batch, ids[j])
		end
		local ok, body = httpGet("https://apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v1/items/details?assetIds=" .. table.concat(batch, ","))
		if ok then
			local okD, decoded = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(body)
			end)
			if okD and type(decoded) == "table" then
				local list = decoded.data or decoded
				if type(list) == "table" then
					for _, e in ipairs(list) do
						if type(e) == "table" then
							local a = e.asset or e
							local rawId = a.id or a.assetId
							if rawId and a.name then
								map[idStr(rawId)] = tostring(a.name)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		i += 30
	end
	return map
end

local function fillNames(items)
	local missing = {}
	for _, it in ipairs(items) do
		if not it.name then
			table.insert(missing, it.id)
		end
	end
	if #missing > 0 then
		local map = fetchNames(missing)
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			if not it.name then
				it.name = map[it.id]
			end
		end
	end
	for _, it in ipairs(items) do
		it.name = tostring(it.name or ("Audio " .. it.id))
	end
end

local ENDPOINTS = {
	function(q, page)
		return "https://apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v1/marketplace/3?limit=30&pageNumber=" .. page .. "&keyword=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(q) .. "&sortType=0"
	end,
	function(q, page)
		return "https://apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v2/assets:search?searchCategoryType=Audio&query=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(q) .. "&maxPageSize=30&pageNumber=" .. page
	end,
}

local function fetchAudio(query, page)
	local errors = {}
	for i, builder in ipairs(ENDPOINTS) do
		local ok, body = httpGet(builder(query, page))
		if ok then
			local okD, decoded = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(body)
			end)
			if okD and type(decoded) == "table" then
				local items = extractItems(decoded)
				if #items > 0 then
					fillNames(items)
					return items, nil
				end
				table.insert(errors, "A" .. i .. ": empty")
			else
				table.insert(errors, "A" .. i .. ": bad response")
			end
		else
			table.insert(errors, "A" .. i .. ": " .. tostring(body))
		end
	end
	return {}, table.concat(errors, " | ")
end

local playToken = 0
local currentSound, currentTrack = nil, nil
local queue, queueIdx = {}, 0
local failStreak = 0
local muted = false
local fadeTween

local function soundParent()
	if CFG.soundMode == "3D" then
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			return root
		end
	end
	return SoundService
end

local function newSound(id)
	local s = Instance.new("Sound")
	s.Name = "SoundHub_Current"
	s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	s.Volume = 0
	s.Looped = false
	s.PlaybackSpeed = CFG.playbackSpeed
	s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	s.RollOffMinDistance = 5
	s.RollOffMaxDistance = 120
	return s
end

local function applyVolume()
	if fadeTween then
		fadeTween:Cancel()
		fadeTween = nil
	end
	if currentSound then
		currentSound.Volume = muted and 0 or CFG.masterVolume
	end
end

local function addRecent(track)
	local i = hasTrack(recent, track.id)
	if i then
		table.remove(recent, i)
	end
	table.insert(recent, 1, { id = track.id, name = track.name })
	while #recent > 40 do
		table.remove(recent)
	end
	saveRecent()
	if renderRecent then
		renderRecent()
	end
end

local function pickIndex(dir)
	local n = #queue
	if n == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	if CFG.shuffle and n > 1 then
		local i
		repeat
			i = math.random(n)
		until i ~= queueIdx
		return i
	end
	local i = queueIdx + dir
	if i > n then
		i = 1
	elseif i < 1 then
		i = n
	end
	return i
end

local function stopSound()
	playToken += 1
	local s = currentSound
	currentSound = nil
	currentTrack = nil
	if fadeTween then
		fadeTween:Cancel()
		fadeTween = nil
	end
	if s then
		if CFG.fadeTime > 0 then
			local tw = TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(CFG.fadeTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Volume = 0 })
			tw.Completed:Connect(function()
				pcall(function()
					s:Destroy()
				end)
			end)
			tw:Play()
		else
			pcall(function()
				s:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	if refreshNowPlaying then
		refreshNowPlaying()
	end
end

local function playTrack(track)
	playToken += 1
	local token = playToken
	if fadeTween then
		fadeTween:Cancel()
		fadeTween = nil
	end
	if currentSound then
		local old = currentSound
		currentSound = nil
		pcall(function()
			old:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	local s = newSound(track.id)
	currentSound = s
	currentTrack = track
	s.Parent = soundParent()
	s:Play()
	if CFG.fadeTime > 0 then
		fadeTween = TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(CFG.fadeTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Volume = muted and 0 or CFG.masterVolume })
		fadeTween:Play()
	else
		s.Volume = muted and 0 or CFG.masterVolume
	end
	addRecent(track)
	refreshNowPlaying()
	s.Ended:Connect(function()
		if currentSound == s then
			onEnded()
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local t0 = tick()
		while tick() - t0 < 8 do
			if playToken ~= token then
				return
			end
			if s.IsLoaded and s.TimeLength > 0 then
				failStreak = 0
				return
			end
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
		if playToken ~= token then
			return
		end
		failStreak += 1
		notify("Cannot play (private or removed): " .. track.name, THEME.Red)
		if failStreak < 5 and #queue > 1 then
			local nextIdx = pickIndex(1)
			if nextIdx then
				playFromQueue(nextIdx)
			end
		else
			failStreak = 0
			stopSound()
		end
	end)
end

function playFromQueue(i)
	if not i or not queue[i] then
		return
	end
	queueIdx = i
	playTrack(queue[i])
end

local function playList(items, idx)
	if #items == 0 then
		return
	end
	queue = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(items) do
		table.insert(queue, { id = t.id, name = t.name })
	end
	playFromQueue(math.clamp(idx or 1, 1, #queue))
end

local function shufflePlay(items)
	if #items == 0 then
		return
	end
	local copy = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(items) do
		table.insert(copy, { id = t.id, name = t.name })
	end
	for i = #copy, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		copy[i], copy[j] = copy[j], copy[i]
	end
	queue = copy
	playFromQueue(1)
end

function onEnded()
	if not currentSound then
		return
	end
	if CFG.repeatMode == "one" then
		currentSound.TimePosition = 0
		currentSound:Play()
		return
	end
	if not CFG.autoNext or #queue == 0 then
		return
	end
	if not CFG.shuffle and CFG.repeatMode == "off" and queueIdx >= #queue then
		stopSound()
		return
	end
	playFromQueue(pickIndex(1))
end

local function playNext()
	if #queue == 0 then
		return
	end
	playFromQueue(pickIndex(1))
end

local function playPrev()
	if currentSound and currentSound.TimePosition > 3 then
		currentSound.TimePosition = 0
		return
	end
	if #queue == 0 then
		return
	end
	playFromQueue(pickIndex(-1))
end

local function playPause()
	if currentSound then
		if currentSound.IsPaused then
			currentSound:Resume()
		elseif currentSound.IsPlaying then
			currentSound:Pause()
		else
			currentSound:Play()
		end
	elseif #queue > 0 then
		playFromQueue(queueIdx > 0 and queueIdx or 1)
	elseif #playlist > 0 then
		playList(playlist, 1)
	end
end

local function reparentSound()
	if currentSound then
		currentSound.Parent = soundParent()
	end
end

local function resolveName(track)
	task.spawn(function()
		local map = fetchNames({ track.id })
		local name = map[track.id]
		if not name then
			return
		end
		track.name = name
		for _, list in ipairs({ playlist, favorites, recent, customPreset }) do
			for _, t in ipairs(list) do
				if t.id == track.id and t.name:match("^Audio %d+$") then
					t.name = name
				end
			end
		end
		saveAll()
		renderAll()
		if refreshNowPlaying then
			refreshNowPlaying()
		end
	end)
end

local function toggleFavorite(track)
	local i = hasTrack(favorites, track.id)
	if i then
		table.remove(favorites, i)
		notify("Removed from favorites", THEME.Orange)
	else
		addUnique(favorites, track)
		notify("Added to favorites", THEME.Green)
	end
	saveFavorites()
	renderFavorites()
end

local function addToPlaylist(track)
	if addUnique(playlist, track) then
		notify("Added to playlist", THEME.Green)
	else

	end
	savePlaylist()
	renderPlaylist()
end

local function tween(inst, t, props)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(inst, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)

	if style == "accent" then
		baseT, color = 0.05, THEME.Accent
	elseif style == "danger" then
		baseT, color = 0.1, THEME.Red
	elseif style == "ghost" then
		baseT = 1
	end
	local b = make("TextButton", {
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Font = FONT_BOLD,
		TextSize = 12,
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = THEME.Text,
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BackgroundTransparency = baseT,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 32),
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(parent),
	}, nil)
	b:SetAttribute("base", baseT)
	corner(b, 999)
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = math.max((b:GetAttribute("base") or baseT) - 0.12, 0) })
	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		tween(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = b:GetAttribute("base") or baseT })
	end)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if callback then
			callback(b)
		end
	end)
	b.Parent = parent
	return b
end

local function grid(parent, columns, count, rowH)
	rowH = rowH or 32
	local rows = math.ceil(count / columns)
	local pad = 8
	local g = make("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rows * rowH + (rows - 1) * pad),
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(parent),
	}, parent)
	make("UIGridLayout", {
		CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / columns - 0.001, -math.ceil(pad * (columns - 1) / columns), 0, rowH),
		CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, pad, 0, pad),
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
	}, g)
	return g
end

local function bindDrag(hit, track, onChange, onDone)
	local dragging = false
	local function update(x)
		local a = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		onChange(a)
	end
	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			update(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			update(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			dragging = false
			if onDone then
				onDone()
			end
		end
	end)
	return function()
		return dragging
	end
end

local function sliderParts(parent, position, size)

		BorderSizePixel = 0,

local function makeSlider(parent, text, minV, maxV, default, fmt, callback)
	local c = card(parent, 56)
	label(c, { Text = text, Font = FONT_BOLD, Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 18) })
	local valueLabel = label(c, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -16, 0, 18),
		TextXAlignment = RIGHT,
		TextColor3 = THEME.SubText,
	})
	local hit, track, fill, knob = sliderParts(c, UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 28), UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24))
	local value = default
	local function visual(v)
		local a = (v - minV) / (maxV - minV)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
		valueLabel.Text = fmt(v)
	end
	visual(default)
	bindDrag(hit, track, function(a)
		local v = minV + (maxV - minV) * a
		value = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		visual(value)
		callback(value, false)
	end, function()
		callback(value, true)
	end)
	return function(v)
		value = v
		visual(v)
	end
end

local function makeToggle(parent, text, default, callback)
	local c = card(parent, 44)
	label(c, { Text = text, Font = FONT_BOLD, Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0) })
	local sw = make("TextButton", {
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "",
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 30),
		BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Off,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
	}, c)
	corner(sw, 999)
	local knob = make("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = THEME.White,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24),
	}, sw)
	corner(knob, 999)
	local state = default
	local function apply(animated)
		local props1 = { BackgroundColor3 = state and THEME.Green or THEME.Off, BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 0.2 }
		local props2 = { Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -27, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0) }
		if animated then
			tween(sw, 0.18, props1)
			tween(knob, 0.18, props2)
		else
			for k, v in pairs(props1) do
				sw[k] = v
			end
			for k, v in pairs(props2) do
				knob[k] = v
			end
		end
	end
	apply(false)
	sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		state = not state
		apply(true)
		callback(state)
	end)
	return function(v)
		state = v
		apply(false)
	end
end

local allLists = {}

local function newList(parent, size, opts)
	local L = { items = {}, rows = {}, selected = nil }
	local holder = make("Frame", {
		BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Inset,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = size,
		LayoutOrder = nextOrder(parent),
	}, parent)
	corner(holder, 20)
	stroke(holder, THEME.White, 0.9, 1)
	local scroll = make("ScrollingFrame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -12),
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 3,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = THEME.White,
		ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
	}, holder)
	make("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, scroll)
	local empty = label(holder, {
		Text = opts.empty or "Nothing here yet",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		TextXAlignment = CENTER,
		TextColor3 = THEME.SubText,
		TextTransparency = 0.2,
	})
	L.scroll = scroll

	function L.refresh()
		local cur = currentTrack and currentTrack.id
		for i, r in ipairs(L.rows) do
			local item = L.items[i]
			local active = opts.active and cur ~= nil and item.id == cur
			r.frame.BackgroundColor3 = active and THEME.Accent or THEME.White
			r.frame.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.45 or 0.86
			r.stroke.Transparency = (L.selected == i) and 0.1 or 0.9
		end
	end

	function L.add(item)
		local idx = #L.items + 1
		L.items[idx] = item
		local frame = make("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = THEME.White,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.86,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48),
			LayoutOrder = idx,
		}, scroll)
		corner(frame, 14)
		local rowStroke = stroke(frame, THEME.White, 0.9, 1)
		local actions = opts.actions or {}
		local widths, total = {}, 0
		for i, a in ipairs(actions) do
			widths[i] = math.max(36, #a.text * 7 + 22)
			total += widths[i] + 6
		end
		local hit = make("TextButton", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		}, frame)
		hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if opts.select then
				L.selected = idx
				L.refresh()
			end
			if opts.click then
				opts.click(item, idx)
			end
		end)
		hit.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
			copyId(item.id)
		end)
		label(frame, {
			Text = item.name,
			Font = FONT_BOLD,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 6),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -(total + 30), 0, 18),
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		})
		label(frame, {
			Text = "ID " .. item.id,
			TextSize = 11,
			TextColor3 = THEME.SubText,
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 26),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -(total + 30), 0, 16),
		})
		local x = -10
		for i = #actions, 1, -1 do
			local a = actions[i]
			local b = button(frame, a.text, function()
				a.fn(item, idx)
			end)
			b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			b.Position = UDim2.new(1, x, 0.5, 0)
			b.Size = UDim2.new(0, widths[i], 0, 28)
			x -= widths[i] + 6
		end
		L.rows[idx] = { frame = frame, stroke = rowStroke }
		empty.Visible = false
		L.refresh()
	end

	function L.clear()
		for _, r in ipairs(L.rows) do
			r.frame:Destroy()
		end
		L.rows = {}
		L.items = {}
		L.selected = nil
		scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		empty.Visible = true
	end

	function L.set(items, keep)
		local pos = scroll.CanvasPosition
		L.clear()
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			L.add(it)
		end
		if keep then
			task.defer(function()
				scroll.CanvasPosition = pos
			end)
		end
	end

	table.insert(allLists, L)
	return L
end

local function selectedResult()
	local idx = searchList.selected
	if idx and searchList.items[idx] then
		return searchList.items[idx], idx
	end

local function checkScrollLoad()
	if searchState.loading or not searchState.hasMore then
		return
	end
	local sc = searchList.scroll
	local remaining = sc.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - (sc.CanvasPosition.Y + sc.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
	if remaining < 120 then
		searchState.start(searchState.token)
	end
end

function searchState.start(token)
	if searchState.loading then
		return
	end
	searchState.loading = true
	searchStatus.Text = (#searchList.items == 0) and "Searching..." or "Loading more..."
	task.spawn(function()
		local fresh, lastErr = {}, nil
		for _ = 1, 2 do
			local items, err = fetchAudio(searchState.query, searchState.page)
			searchState.page += 1
			if token ~= searchState.token then
				return
			end
			lastErr = err
			for _, it in ipairs(items) do
				if not searchState.seen[it.id] then
					searchState.seen[it.id] = true
					table.insert(fresh, it)
				end
			end
			if #fresh > 0 or err then
				break
			end
		end
		if token ~= searchState.token then
			return
		end
		searchState.loading = false
		for _, it in ipairs(fresh) do
			searchList.add(it)
		end
		searchState.hasMore = #fresh > 0
		if #searchList.items == 0 then
			searchStatus.Text = lastErr and ("Search failed - " .. lastErr) or "No results found"
		else
			searchStatus.Text = #searchList.items .. " results" .. (searchState.hasMore and " - scroll for more" or " - end of results")
		end
		task.defer(checkScrollLoad)
	end)
end

local function doSearch(text)
	searchBox.Text = text
	searchState.token += 1
	searchState.query = text
	searchState.page = 0
	searchState.loading = false
	searchState.hasMore = false
	searchState.seen = {}
	searchList.clear()
	searchState.start(searchState.token)
end

			local a = math.clamp(s.TimePosition / len, 0, 1)
			progFill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
			progKnob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
		end
	elseif not progDragging() then
		progFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
		progKnob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end

	textAccum += dt
	if textAccum >= 0.2 then
		textAccum = 0
		if s then
			timeLeft.Text = formatTime(s.TimePosition)
			timeRight.Text = formatTime(s.TimeLength)
			playBtn.Text = s.IsPlaying and "Pause" or "Play"
		else

			timeRight.Text = "0:00"
			playBtn.Text = "Play"
		end
	end

	if main.Visible and pageViz.Visible then
		vizTime += dt
		local level = 0
		if s and s.IsPlaying then
			level = math.clamp(s.PlaybackLoudness / 500, 0, 1)
		end
		for i, b in ipairs(vizBars) do
			local wave = 0.45 + 0.55 * math.abs(math.sin(vizTime * (1.5 + i * 0.13) + i))

			vizValues[i] = vizValues[i] + (target - vizValues[i]) * math.clamp(dt * 14, 0, 1)

	end
	if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then

	end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == CFG.uiKey then
		setVisible(not main.Visible)
		return
	end
	if processed then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then

local function makeDraggable(handle, target, onTap, onEnd)
	local dragging, moved, startIn, startPos = false, false, nil, nil
	keep(handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging, moved = true, false
			startIn, startPos = input.Position, target.Position
			local ch
			ch = input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
					ch:Disconnect()
					if not moved and onTap then onTap() end
					if moved and onEnd then onEnd() end
				end
			end)
		end
	end))
	keep(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local d = input.Position - startIn
			if d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
			if moved then
				local sc = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
				local k = sc and sc.Scale or 1
				target.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X / k, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y / k)
			end
		end
	end))
end

local function notify(title, msg, kind, dur)
	if not S.ui.notify and kind ~= "bad" then return end
	notifN = notifN + 1
	local children = NotifHolder:GetChildren()
	local count = 0
	for _, ch in ipairs(children) do if ch:IsA("Frame") then count = count + 1 end end
	if count >= 4 then
		for _, ch in ipairs(children) do
			if ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy(); break end
		end
	end
	local slot = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 62), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = notifN }, NotifHolder)
	local card = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 60, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = T.card, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, slot)

	new("TextLabel", { Text = title, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.text, BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 17), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd }, card)

	tween(card, 0.35, { Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	task.delay(dur or 2.4, function()
		if card.Parent then
			tween(card, 0.25, { Position = UDim2.new(1, 60, 0, 0) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

	local r = row(g, 58)
	new("TextLabel", { Text = text, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.text, BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 20) }, r)
	local chip = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 22), Position = UDim2.new(1, -83, 0, 8), BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, r)
	corner(chip, 7)
	local val = new("TextLabel", { Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = A1, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0) }, chip)
	onAccent(function(a) val.TextColor3 = a end)
	local track = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 13, 1, -17), Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 6), BackgroundColor3 = T.line, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, r)
	corner(track, 3)
	local fill = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, track)
	corner(fill, 3)
	gradient(fill, 0)
	local knob = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3 }, track)
	corner(knob, 8)
	local hit = new("TextButton", { Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), ZIndex = 5 }, r)
	local fmt = step < 1 and "%.2f" or "%.0f"
	local cur = init
	local function render()
		local a = (cur - min) / (max - min)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
		val.Text = string.format(fmt, cur) .. (unit or "")
	end
	local dragging = false
	local function endDrag()
		if dragging then
			dragging = false
			g.page.ScrollingEnabled = true
			tween(knob, 0.15, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16) })
		end
	end
	local function apply(x)
		local a = clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		local v = clamp(math.floor((min + (max - min) * a) / step + 0.5) * step, min, max)
		if v ~= cur then
			cur = v
			render()
			cb(v)
		end
	end
	keep(hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			g.page.ScrollingEnabled = false
			tween(knob, 0.12, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(21, 21) })
			apply(input.Position.X)
		end
	end))
	keep(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End or input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then endDrag() else apply(input.Position.X) end
		end
	end))
	keep(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then endDrag() end
	end))
	render()
end

local aimTarget = nil

local function pickAimTarget(c, vp)
	local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
	local best, bestD, bestPos
	for _, t in ipairs(listTargets(S.aim.plrs, S.aim.bots)) do
		local part = aimPart(t, S.aim.part)
		local sp, on = c:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
		if on then
			local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
			if d <= S.aim.fov and (not bestD or d < bestD) then
				if not S.aim.wall or visible(c, t, part) then
					best, bestD, bestPos = t, d, part.Position
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best, bestPos
end

local HIT_SIGNALS = { "MouseButton1Down", "MouseButton1Up", "MouseButton1Click", "Activated", "TouchTap" }
local INPUT_SIGNALS = { "InputBegan", "InputEnded" }
local function hitButton()
	local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	local g = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("MCTouch")
	return g and g:FindFirstChild("Hit")
end

-- synthetic touch for games that read InputBegan / InputEnded on the button itself
local function fakeInput(pos)
	local f = {
		UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch, UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
		Position = Vector3.new(pos.X, pos.Y, 0), Delta = Vector3.zero, KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
	}
	local cbs = {}
	f.Changed = { Connect = function(_, fn) cbs[#cbs + 1] = fn; return { Disconnect = function() end } end }
	f.finish = function()
		f.UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.End
		for _, fn in ipairs(cbs) do pcall(fn, "UserInputState") end
	end
	return f
end
local function fireConn(c, ...)
	if c.Fire then c:Fire(...) elseif c.Function then c.Function(...) end
end

local warnedHit = false
local function pressHit()
	local btn = hitButton()
	if not btn then return false end
	local fired = 0
	for _, name in ipairs(HIT_SIGNALS) do
		local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, btn[name])
		if ok and type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 then
			if pcall(firesignal, btn[name]) then fired = fired + 1 end
		end
	end
	if fired == 0 then
		local okB, began = pcall(getconnections, btn.InputBegan)
		local okE, ended = pcall(getconnections, btn.InputEnded)
		local nB = (okB and type(began) == "table") and #began or 0
		local nE = (okE and type(ended) == "table") and #ended or 0
		if nB + nE > 0 then
			fired = 1
			local pos = btn.AbsolutePosition + btn.AbsoluteSize / 2
			task.spawn(function()
				local fi = fakeInput(pos)
				if nB > 0 then for _, c in ipairs(began) do pcall(fireConn, c, fi) end end
				task.wait(0.03)
				fi.finish()
				if nE > 0 then for _, c in ipairs(ended) do pcall(fireConn, c, fi) end end
			end)
		end
	end
	if fired == 0 then
		-- touch fallback only while the hub is hidden, so it can never click the hub itself
		if VirtualInputManager and not hubOpen then
			local p = btn.AbsolutePosition + btn.AbsoluteSize / 2
			pcall(function()
				VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(p.X, p.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
				VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(p.X, p.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
			end)
		elseif not warnedHit then
			warnedHit = true
			notify("Auto hit", "The HIT button has no hooks I can fire. Tap the L bubble to hide the hub so the touch fallback can run, or open Probe and run Test HIT.", "warn", 6)
		end
	end
	return fired > 0
end

local lastHit = 0
local function stepTrigger()
	if not S.trig.on then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastHit < S.trig.delay then return end
	local root, c = myRoot(), cam()
	if not root or not c then return end
	local vp = c.ViewportSize
	local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
	for _, t in ipairs(listTargets(S.aim.plrs, S.aim.bots)) do
		if (t.root.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= S.trig.reach then
			local part = aimPart(t, S.aim.part)
			local sp, on = c:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			if on and (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude <= S.trig.radius and (not S.aim.wall or visible(c, t, part)) then
				lastHit = now
				pressHit()
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

-- hitbox expander
local hbOrig = {}
local function hbRestoreOne(part)
	local o = hbOrig[part]
	if o and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.Size = o.size; part.CanCollide = o.cc end) end
	hbOrig[part] = nil
end
local function hbRestore()
	for part in pairs(hbOrig) do hbRestoreOne(part) end
end
local function stepHitbox()
	if not S.hit.on then
		if next(hbOrig) then hbRestore() end
		return
	end
	local seen = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(listTargets(true, true)) do
		local p = t.model:FindFirstChild(S.hit.part)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
			if not hbOrig[p] then hbOrig[p] = { size = p.Size, cc = p.CanCollide } end
			p.Size = Vector3.new(S.hit.size, S.hit.size, S.hit.size)
			p.CanCollide = false
			seen[p] = true
		end
	end
	for part in pairs(hbOrig) do
		if not seen[part] then hbRestoreOne(part) end
	end
end

local function destroyEsp(o)
	for _, k in ipairs({ "box", "tag", "line", "hl" }) do
		if o[k] then pcall(function() o[k]:Destroy() end) end
	end
end

local function stepEsp(c, vp)
	local cur = {}
	if S.esp.on then
		for _, t in ipairs(listTargets(S.esp.plrs, S.esp.bots)) do cur[t.model] = t end
	end
	for m, o in pairs(espObjs) do
		if not cur[m] then destroyEsp(o); espObjs[m] = nil end
	end
	local camPos = c.CFrame.Position
	local dists, order = {}, {}
	for m, t in pairs(cur) do
		dists[m] = (camPos - t.root.Position).Magnitude
		order[#order + 1] = m
	end
	local chamOk = {}
	if S.esp.chams then
		table.sort(order, function(a, b) return dists[a] < dists[b] end)
		for i = 1, math.min(CHAM_LIMIT, #order) do chamOk[order[i]] = true end
	end
	local origin = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
	for m, t in pairs(cur) do
		local o = espObjs[m]
		if not o then o = createEsp(t); espObjs[m] = o end
		o.t = t
		local col = t.bot and BOT_COLOR or PALETTE[S.esp.color][2]
		local dist = dists[m]
		local show = dist <= S.esp.maxd
		o.box.Enabled = show and (S.esp.box or S.esp.hp)
		o.outline.Visible = S.esp.box
		o.barBg.Visible = S.esp.hp
		o.stroke.Color = col
		local mh = math.max(t.hum.MaxHealth, 1)
		local pct = clamp(t.hum.Health / mh, 0, 1)
		o.bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, pct, 0)
		o.bar.BackgroundColor3 = T.bad:Lerp(T.good, pct)
		local parts = {}
		if S.esp.name then parts[#parts + 1] = t.name end
		if S.esp.hp then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d/%d", math.floor(t.hum.Health + 0.5), math.floor(mh + 0.5)) end
		if S.esp.dist then parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%dst", math.floor(dist + 0.5)) end
		local txt = table.concat(parts, "  |  ")
		if txt ~= o.txt then o.txt = txt; o.label.Text = txt end
		o.label.TextColor3 = col
		o.tag.Enabled = show and #parts > 0
		local drawLine = false
		if S.esp.tracer and show then
			local sp, on = c:WorldToViewportPoint(t.root.Position)
			if on then
				local b = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
				local d = b - origin
				o.line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((origin.X + b.X) / 2, (origin.Y + b.Y) / 2)
				o.line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d.Magnitude, 1.5)
				o.line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
				o.line.BackgroundColor3 = col
				drawLine = true
			end
		end
		o.line.Visible = drawLine
		if S.esp.chams and show and chamOk[m] then
			if not o.hl then
				o.hl = new("Highlight", { Adornee = t.model, FillTransparency = 0.65, OutlineTransparency = 0, DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop }, espRoot)
			end
			o.hl.FillColor = col
			o.hl.OutlineColor = col
			o.hl.Enabled = true
		elseif o.hl then
			o.hl.Enabled = false
		end
	end
end

local humOrig
local function setHum(on)
	local hum = myHum()
	if on then
		if hum and not humOrig then humOrig = { WalkSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed, JumpPower = hum.JumpPower, UseJumpPower = hum.UseJumpPower } end
	elseif humOrig then
		if hum then pcall(function() for k, v in pairs(humOrig) do hum[k] = v end end) end

	end

-- returns (right, forward) in -1..1, camera relative
local function moveInput()
	local c = cam()
	if not c then return 0, 0 end
	local look = c.CFrame.LookVector
	local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return 0, 0 end
	flat = flat.Unit
	local right = Vector3.new(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X)
	local hum = myHum()
	if hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then
		local md = hum.MoveDirection
		return md:Dot(right), md:Dot(flat)
	end
	local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	local touch = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("MCTouch")
	local stick = touch and touch:FindFirstChild("StickBase")
	local knob = stick and stick:FindFirstChild("Knob")
	if stick and knob then
		local rad = stick.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
		local off = (knob.AbsolutePosition + knob.AbsoluteSize / 2) - (stick.AbsolutePosition + stick.AbsoluteSize / 2)
		if rad > 0 and off.Magnitude > rad * 0.15 then
			local v = off / rad
			if v.Magnitude > 1 then v = v.Unit end
			return v.X, -v.Y
		end
	end
	return 0, 0
end

local function stepMovement(dt)
	local root, hum, c = myRoot(), myHum(), cam()
	if not root or not c then return end
	if S.mov.hum and hum then
		if not humOrig then setHum(true) end
		hum.WalkSpeed = S.mov.ws
		hum.UseJumpPower = true
		hum.JumpPower = S.mov.jp
	end
	if S.mov.fly then
		local r, f = moveInput()
		local v = c.CFrame.LookVector * f + c.CFrame.RightVector * r
		if v.Magnitude > 1 then v = v.Unit end
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		if v.Magnitude > 0.02 then root.CFrame = root.CFrame + v * (S.mov.flyv * dt) end
	elseif S.mov.speed then
		local r, f = moveInput()
		local look = c.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude > 1e-3 then
			flat = flat.Unit
			local right = Vector3.new(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X)
			local v = flat * f + right * r
			if v.Magnitude > 1 then v = v.Unit end
			if v.Magnitude > 0.02 then root.CFrame = root.CFrame + v * (S.mov.speedv * dt) end
		end
	end
end

local function hop()
	if not S.mov.ijump then return end
	local hum, root = myHum(), myRoot()
	if hum then pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end) end
	if root then
		local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X, 52, v.Z)
	end
end
