---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function ser(v, d)
	d = d or 0
	local t = typeof(v)
	if t == "string" then return string.format("%q", v)
	elseif t == "table" then
		if d > 2 then return "{...}" end
		local parts, n = {}, 0
		for k, x in pairs(v) do
			n = n + 1
			if n > 12 then parts[#parts + 1] = "..."; break end
			parts[#parts + 1] = "[" .. ser(k, d + 1) .. "]=" .. ser(x, d + 1)
		end
		return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. "}"
	elseif t == "Instance" then
		local ok, n = pcall(function() return v:GetFullName() end)
		return ok and n or tostring(v)
	end
	return tostring(v)
end

local function installSpy()
	if env.__LUNYX_HOOKED then return true end
	if not (hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod) then return false end
	local old
	local wrap = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
	old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", wrap(function(self, ...)
		local method = getnamecallmethod()
		if method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer" then
			local fn = env.__LUNYX_SPYFN
			if fn then fn(self, method, ...) end
		end
		if setnamecallmethod then setnamecallmethod(method) end
		return old(self, ...)
	end))
	env.__LUNYX_HOOKED = true
	return true
end

env.__LUNYX_SPYFN = function(remote, method, ...)
	if not alive or not S.probe.spy then return end
	local ok, parent = pcall(function() return remote.Parent end)
	if not ok or not parent or parent.Name ~= "MCRemotes" then return end
	local name = remote.Name
	if not S.probe.spam and (name == "Look" or name == "Sync") then return end
	if checkcaller and checkcaller() then return end
	local args = table.pack(...)
	local stamp = os.clock() % 1000
	task.defer(function()
		local strs = {}
		for i = 1, args.n do strs[i] = ser(args[i]) end
		log(string.format("[%.2f] %s:%s(%s)", stamp, name, method, table.concat(strs, ", ")))
	end)
end

local function resolveDump(label)
	local scope, name = label:match("^(%w+)%.(.+)$")
	if scope == "Pof" then
		local ps = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
		local base = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PoFClient")
		return base and base:FindFirstChild(name)
	end
	local cur = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
	if scope == "Config" then cur = cur and cur:FindFirstChild("Config") end
	for part in name:gmatch("[^%.]+") do cur = cur and cur:FindFirstChild(part) end
	return cur
end

local function dumpModule(label)
	local ms = resolveDump(label)
	if not ms then log("dump: " .. label .. " not found"); return end
	local ok, mod = pcall(require, ms)
	if not ok then log("dump: require failed: " .. tostring(mod)); return end
	log("== " .. label .. " (" .. type(mod) .. ")")
	if type(mod) ~= "table" then log(tostring(mod)); return end
	local list = {}
	for k, v in pairs(mod) do list[#list + 1] = { tostring(k), v } end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
	for i, kv in ipairs(list) do
		if i > 90 then log("... +" .. (#list - 90) .. " more"); break end
		local v, tv = kv[2], type(kv[2])
		local shown = tv
		if tv == "number" or tv == "boolean" or tv == "string" then
			shown = tv .. " = " .. tostring(v)
		elseif tv == "table" then
			local n = 0
			for _ in pairs(v) do n = n + 1 end
			shown = "table(" .. n .. ")"
		end
		log("  " .. kv[1] .. " : " .. shown)
	end
end

local CFG_MODULES = { "Physics", "Combat", "Projectiles", "Dev", "Experiments", "Presentation" }
local cfgFields = {}
local cfgName, cfgFilter = "Physics", ""
local cfgBox, cfgInfo
local cfgRender

local function cfgLoad(name)
	if cfgFields[name] then return cfgFields[name] end
	local shared = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
	local folder = shared and shared:FindFirstChild("Config")
	local ms = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not ms or not ms:IsA("ModuleScript") then log("config: " .. name .. " not found"); return nil end
	local ok, mod = pcall(require, ms)
	if not ok or type(mod) ~= "table" then log("config: " .. name .. " require failed: " .. tostring(mod)); return nil end
	local out, seen = {}, { [mod] = true }
	local function walk(tbl, prefix, depth)
		for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
			local path = prefix == "" and tostring(k) or (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k))
			local tv = type(v)
			if tv == "number" or tv == "boolean" then
				out[#out + 1] = { path = path, parent = tbl, key = k, orig = v }
			elseif tv == "table" and depth < 3 and not seen[v] then
				seen[v] = true
				walk(v, path, depth + 1)
			end
		end
	end
	walk(mod, "", 0)
	table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.path < b.path end)
	cfgFields[name] = out
	return out
end

local function cfgSet(parent, key, v)
	local ok = pcall(function() parent[key] = v end)
	if (not ok or rawget(parent, key) ~= v) and setreadonly then
		pcall(setreadonly, parent, false)
		ok = pcall(function() parent[key] = v end)
	end
	return ok and rawget(parent, key) == v
end

local function fmtNum(v)
	return tostring(math.floor(v * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000)
end

local function buildCfgRow(f, order)
	local r = new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order }, cfgBox)
	if order > 1 then
		new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 0), BackgroundColor3 = T.line, BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, r)
	end
	new("TextLabel", {
		Text = f.path, Font = FONT, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = T.text, BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -124, 1, 0),
	}, r)
	local function flash(good)
		r.BackgroundColor3 = good and Color3.fromRGB(34, 70, 52) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 34, 44)
		r.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
		tween(r, 0.6, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	end
	if type(f.orig) == "boolean" then
		local b = new("TextButton", { Text = tostring(f.parent[f.key]), Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = A1, BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi, AutoButtonColor = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -105, 0.5, -12), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, r)
		corner(b, 8)
		keep(b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local nv = not f.parent[f.key]
			if cfgSet(f.parent, f.key, nv) then b.Text = tostring(nv); flash(true) else flash(false) end
		end))
	else
		local tb = new("TextBox", { Text = fmtNum(f.parent[f.key]), ClearTextOnFocus = false, Font = FONTB, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = A1, BackgroundColor3 = T.cardHi, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -105, 0.5, -12), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, r)
		corner(tb, 8)
		keep(tb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local n = tonumber(tb.Text)
			if n and cfgSet(f.parent, f.key, n) then flash(true) else flash(false); tb.Text = fmtNum(f.parent[f.key]) end
		end))
	end
end

cfgRender = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(cfgBox:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local fields = cfgLoad(cfgName)
	if not fields then cfgInfo.Text = cfgName .. ": could not load (see Probe log)"; return end
	local shown, matched = 0, 0
	for _, f in ipairs(fields) do
		if cfgFilter == "" or f.path:lower():find(cfgFilter, 1, true) then
			matched = matched + 1
			if shown < 70 then
				shown = shown + 1
				buildCfgRow(f, shown)
			end
		end
	end
	cfgInfo.Text = string.format("%s: %d values, showing %d. Edits are client-side only.", cfgName, #fields, shown)
	if matched > shown then cfgInfo.Text = cfgInfo.Text .. " Narrow the filter for the rest." end
end

local function toggleWin()
	if hubOpen then
		hubOpen = false
		unlockScroll()
		tween(RootScale, 0.16, { Scale = RootScale.Scale * 0.9 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
		task.delay(0.16, function()
			if alive and not hubOpen then Root.Visible = false end
		end)
	else
		hubOpen = true
		local target = fitScale * S.ui.scale
		RootScale.Scale = target * 0.9

		tween(RootScale, 0.28, { Scale = target }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)

local function snapBubble()
	local c = cam()
	if not c then return end
	local vp = c.ViewportSize
	local ap = Bubble.AbsolutePosition
	local x = (ap.X + 23 < vp.X / 2) and 12 or (vp.X - 58)
	local y = clamp(ap.Y, 10, vp.Y - 56)
	tween(Bubble, 0.25, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
end
makeDraggable(Bubble, Bubble, toggleWin, snapBubble)

keep(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if not gpe and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then toggleWin() end
end))

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- loops
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local lastNudge = os.clock()
local function renderStep(dt)
	local c = cam()
	if not c then return end
	local vp = c.ViewportSize
	aimTarget = nil
	if S.aim.on then
		local t, pos = pickAimTarget(c, vp)
		if t then
			aimTarget = t
			local cf = c.CFrame
			local a = 1 - (1 - S.aim.smooth) ^ (dt * 60)
			c.CFrame = cf:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position, pos), clamp(a, 0, 1))
		end
	end
	circle.Visible = S.aim.on and S.aim.circle
	if circle.Visible then
		circle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S.aim.fov * 2, S.aim.fov * 2)
		circle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)
		circleStroke.Color = aimTarget and T.good or A1
	end
	if S.vis.fov then c.FieldOfView = S.vis.fovv end
	if S.misc.afk and os.clock() - lastNudge > 25 then
		lastNudge = os.clock()
		c.CFrame = c.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(0.15), 0)
	end
	stepEsp(c, vp)
end

RunService:BindToRenderStep("LunyxToFStep", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function(dt)
	if not alive then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(renderStep, dt)
	if not ok then log("render: " .. tostring(err)) end
end)

local function getPing()
	local ok, v = pcall(function() return Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
	return ok and v or 0
end

local acc, statAcc, frames = 0, 0, 0
keep(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not alive then return end
	pcall(stepMovement, dt)
	pcall(stepTrigger)
	pcall(stepLighting)
	acc = acc + dt
	if acc >= 0.2 then
		acc = 0
		pcall(stepHitbox)
	end
	flushLog()
	frames = frames + 1
	statAcc = statAcc + dt
	if statAcc >= 0.5 then
		local fps = frames / statAcc
		frames, statAcc = 0, 0
		local ping = getPing()
		Mark.Text = string.format('<font color="%s">LUNYX</font>  <font color="%s">%d fps   %d ms</font>', rgbStr(A1), rgbStr(T.sub), math.floor(fps + 0.5), math.floor(ping + 0.5))
		footerLbl.Text = string.format("%d fps  |  %d ms\nv2  |  Delta", math.floor(fps + 0.5), math.floor(ping + 0.5))
		pcall(refreshActive)
	end
end))

if VirtualUser then
	keep(LP.Idled:Connect(function()
		if S.misc.afk then
			pcall(function()
				VirtualUser:CaptureController()
				VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
			end)
		end
	end))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- teardown
---------------------------------------------------------------------
Destroy = function()
	if not alive then return end
	alive = false
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("LunyxToFStep") end)
	pcall(hbRestore)
	pcall(setFull, false)
	pcall(setFog, false)
	pcall(setClean, false)
	pcall(setFov, false)
	pcall(setHum, false)
	for _, o in pairs(espObjs) do destroyEsp(o) end
	for _, f in ipairs(cleanups) do pcall(f) end
	pcall(function() espRoot:Destroy() end)
	pcall(function() Gui:Destroy() end)
	pcall(function() Draw:Destroy() end)
	env.__LUNYX_SPYFN = nil
	env.__LUNYX_TOF = nil
end
env.__LUNYX_TOF = { Destroy = Destroy }

if game.PlaceId ~= 108114331578868 then log("note: PlaceId differs from Towers of Fortune") end
Root.Visible = true
refreshActive()
notify("Lunyx loaded", "Tap the L bubble to hide or show the hub", "ok", 3)
